jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer | Identity and Access Management | Full-Stack
jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.

Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What Sets Us Apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication
. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.

You will join the Identity and Access Management team
. Owning DeepL's full identity stack: organisation, account and session management, SSO federation, SCIM provisioning, and the OIDC provider, for both internal and external users. It is the foundation every DeepL product relies on to authenticate and authorise users securely and at scale. When identity is unavailable, no one can log in, so reliability and performance sit at the heart of everything the team does.

We are shifting gears from "Software-First" to "Product-First." We don't hire engineers to simply maintain legacy endpoints or close Jira tickets. We hire Missionaries
— builders who obsess over the Why before the How. You will contribute across the stack, shipping features that create delightful, frictionless experiences for both external developers and internal engineering teams.

Your Responsibilities

Own the Identity Experience End-to-End: You will architect and build complex, user-facing features across our identity stack. You will own business-critical systems from the initial problem definition through to architectural design, deployment, and production reliability. You measure success by user impact, not just pull requests merged
Build for "Consumer-Grade" Enterprise: You understand that authentication and authorization systems cannot fail. You build for reliability and maintainability, while delivering a user-friendly experience. You will lead incident response, and continuously raise the bar on code quality and operational health
Collaborate to Raise the Bar: You will work closely with teammates across Identity and adjacent teams - other product teams, Product Management and Support. You will lead designs, scoping, shaping, and solving hard product and technical challenges in collaboration with your team and other engineers
Drive Technical Pragmatism: Whether using our core stack (C#/.NET Core, Kubernetes, Postgres) or exploring new tools, you choose the technology that solves the customer problem most effectively, ensuring long-term maintainability over short-term trends. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving

Qualities we look for

Extreme Ownership & Operational Excellence: You own your services end-to-end (production operations, incident response, and on-call) and you're motivated by pushing reliability toward four nines. You write comprehensive tests, monitor the systems in production, and you treat each incident as an opportunity to learn
A "System Thinker" Mindset: You don't just know syntax; you understand failure modes, system boundaries, and how your code impacts the broader architecture at scale. You can design systems that deliver high availability for our millions of users.
Backend Mastery at Scale (C# / .NET): You have deep expertise designing scalable backend systems and distributed architectures, and you've worked with high-scale distributed systems in production. Strong system design is core to how you work. Roughly 80-90% of the work is backend; working on the frontend (React/Javascript) is a welcome plus, not a requirement
Enterprise Domain Curiosity: You are interested in the hard problems of B2B SaaS Identity - authentication (SSO/OIDC), authorization, and requirements such as security and auditing. You understand that these aren't "boring details"; they are the pillars of trust for enterprise clients
AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like GitHub Copilot or Claude) to accelerate your velocity and eliminate repetitive toil. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving

A Note on Our Hiring Process:
DeepL hires for the Company
, not just a specific team. We operate a Unified Engineering Pipeline
. If you pass our bar, we will match you to the highest-priority role that fits your skillset—whether that is in Core Product, Platform, Voice, or Enterprise. We prioritize "Missionaries" who want to solve the biggest problems, wherever they live in the stack.

What We Offer

Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
Virtual Shares: An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.
Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.
Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.

We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Checkout.com is looking for an ambitious Senior Engineering Manager to join our Disputes team. Our mission is to build the tools, services, and models that help merchants manage and win disputes at scale - reducing the cost and operational burden of chargebacks while protecting revenue for our merchants and our business.

Disputes sit at the intersection of merchant-facing products, complex scheme and regulatory processes, and data-driven decisioning. Our team owns the full stack, anchored by a .NET back end that manages the dispute lifecycle and integrates with card schemes, alongside the front-end experiences merchants use to track and respond to disputes and the machine learning models that predict outcomes and recommend the best action on every case.

We're building for scale, and that scale brings ambiguity, shifting priorities, and the occasional setback - so we're looking for a resilient leader who has built and sustained high-performing teams, learned from failure, and come back stronger. Above all, you'll be someone who drives predictable delivery and operational efficiency: shipping consistently, running systems reliably, and continuously improving how the team works. The ideal candidate has operated across both enterprise and scale-up environments and has a proven track record of driving growth within large, complex, regulated organisations.

Key Responsibilities

Lead a team centred on a .NET back end, with front-end and machine learning components, helping engineers establish and validate their understanding of technical architecture and design end-user-centric systems and tools.
Own predictable, high-velocity delivery — establishing healthy engineering practices, sensible estimation, and a smooth path from idea to production so the team ships consistently and sustainably.
Drive operational efficiency and reliability by automating processes — including monitoring and alerting — meeting SLAs/SLOs, reducing operational cost, and minimising toil to keep the team focused on high-value work rather t
Continuously improve delivery and operational metrics (e.g. cycle time, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and incident response), using data to identify bottlenecks and raises the bar over time.
Manage team engineers across various seniority levels and disciplines while staying hands-on when needed. Cultivate an inclusive environment where every team member feels they belong, and mentors them in both their career development and interpersonal skills. Make a good team great, and keep it great..
Oversee quarterly execution of roadmap delivery, ensuring the team stays focused on the right priorities and manages efficiently through dependencies and cross-functional hurdles.
Collaborate across Engineering, Product, and Operations to deliver solutions for merchant and internal dispute use cases.
Build and strengthen relationships with engineers, managers, and people leads across multiple teams.
Operating in a highly regulated financial space, ensure compliance with a range of control frameworks — from internal stakeholders such as InfoSec and Internal
Audit, to external auditors, card schemes, and regulators.
Oversee the responsible use of machine learning and AI in dispute decisioning, leading the team to develop the infrastructure, tooling, and governance required to run models safely and at scale in production.

About You

A resilient leader who has learned from setbacks and failures and consistently comes back stronger, keeping teams steady and delivering through periods of change and ambiguity.
You thrive on pace. You're energised by a high-growth environment, comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, and you keep the team moving and shipping when priorities shift under you.
A proven track record of driving predictable delivery and operational efficiency — improving throughput, reliability, and the team's cost of operation, and using metrics to back it up.
Proven experience building, growing, and sustaining high-performing engineering teams over time — not just standing them up.
Experience across both enterprise and scale-up environments, with a demonstrated track record of driving growth and delivery within large, complex, regulated organisations.
A strong back-end engineering background, ideally in .NET / C#, leading teams building scalable, event-driven services and APIs. Comfortable also overseeing front-end and machine learning work, able to earn credibility and make sound trade-offs across disciplines even where you aren't the deepest expert.
Able to partner with Product Management to assess technical feasibility, provide capacity estimates, and balance new features against architectural health.
Excellent time management and proactive problem-solving skills.

Technologies we work with

Back end (primary): .NET / C#, REST APIs, event-driven and microservice architectures.
Front end: React, TypeScript.
Machine learning: Python, model training and serving, and the infrastructure to run models in production.
Data & platform: SQL, plus experience designing batch and stream data-processing systems.
Cloud & tooling: AWS and/or GCP, Docker, Terraform, and observability tooling such as Datadog.
Knowledge of Kubernetes, Kafka, and CI/CD pipelines is highly beneficial.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at
Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

Alto Software Group is a B2B SaaS company that powers more than half of all UK housing transactions each year. We create software solutions that connect businesses and consumers, delivering a one-stop shop for estate agents and home builders. Our goal is to drive efficiency, speed up transactions, reduce risk, and improve the end-customer experience.

That means new frontier AI capabilities in TypeScript, sitting alongside a C# estate we're actively evolving for the next era. The interesting challenge isn't just being productive in both stacks, it's knowing when each is the right tool and keeping the whole system coherent as our product grows. Identify the right problems to solve across a dual-stack C# and TypeScript backend, being intentional about choosing the right tool for the job
Implement microfrontend web applications in React and TypeScript, with an eye for component design and the UX implications of what you build

Work closely with our product team and engage customers to understand the problems worth solving, bringing that perspective back into how you design and build

Help shape how we build, not just what we build. Exploring how AI can remove repetitive toil and tighten feedback loops so we spend our energy on the problems worth solving

Our Technology Stack

Backend: TypeScript, Node.js, C#, .NET
Frontend: TypeScript, React
Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS (ECS, Lambda, SQS, DocumentDB, DynamoDB), Terraform, SST (Infrastructure as Code)
Architecture: Microservices, Microfrontends, Event-driven architecture

Our Power and Low Carbon Solutions practice is growing and we will be looking for experienced Platform Software Engineers to join the team. If you are interested in roles like the one described here, please register your interest and we'll be in touch as soon as something suitable becomes available.

Baringa are world leaders in modelling energy markets and using the insights these models provide to drive change in a decarbonising energy industry. We deal with highly varied modelling, data, and processing - everything from kilobytes of academic papers to terabytes of hourly scenario projections for 50+ years.

Our staff come from diverse backgrounds, based across multiple geographies, and utilise a variety of technologies, tools and analytical modelling approaches. They need rapid access to data, analytics outputs, and processing through GUIs, APIs and other systems, whilst being given the confidence that everything is compliant, licenced and well-governed. Our scale and model complexity has now reached a point that to continue to achieve our business vision, we are building a dedicated global Platform team.

We will be looking for experienced software engineers to join as core members of this team to help architect, implement and support the tools that will be fundamental to Baringa’s ongoing growth and success.

This is a high calibre team, where curiosity and a thirst to understand the problem space is not just encouraged, but prioritised. There will be a range of engineering challenges to solve at all levels, requiring the flexibility to adopt the right technology for a given problem space. Our next generation platform will be core to driving significant improvements to the lives and capabilities of our Baringa colleagues in the energy modelling space. Successful candidates will be given responsibility and freedom from day one, trusted to challenge and be challenged in turn, in an environment that rewards creativity and entrepreneurship as we build the foundations for Baringa’s future.

Come and join us to be part of the energy transition, the defining challenge of our lifetimes, where your technical skills and experience can have real impact.

What You Will Be Doing

We will be looking for an experienced software engineer to be a core member of the new Platform team, working closely with the Engineering Lead. You will be working within our Energy and Resources group to:

Be an integral part of the design, build, and ongoing development of a new data platform, with associated tools and software - this will be almost entirely greenfield opportunities to create a holistic user experience for Baringa staff. You will assist the Engineering Lead in the selection of technologies and approaches to build everything from big data platforms through to browser plugins and shared functional libraries.
Work closely with the Engineering Lead to engage tool developers, energy system modellers, client facing energy experts and users across the business to build a platform and supporting toolchain that fulfils the needs of your Baringa colleagues.
Be a driving force in the development, automated testing and deployment of the new platform, utilising best-practices to ensure quality, reliability and monitoring is built-in from inception.
Work with the team to build a DevOps pipeline with robust CI and CD practices, with a focus on evolving our processes to improve our team’s engineering experience.
Be an active part of the team’s agile development approach, from refinement through to demonstration and feedback, helping drive the continuous improvement of team processes as we grow and mature.

Your Skills And Experience

We will be looking for people to join the team who will be committed to designing and building high quality and fit-for-purpose systems, enabling our staff to maximise the creation, utilisation and management of the various models, tools and data frameworks that enable market-leading insights for our clients.

You are passionate about building the ‘right’ solution to problems, and understanding the ‘why’ behind what you’re building to support Baringa’s work in the energy sector.
You have practical experience as a senior engineer in highly motivated engineering team(s), collaborating closely with colleagues and taking pride in what you create.
You are great at problem solving and see all technologies/engineering as a means to achieve this.
You have advanced working knowledge of a general programming language (e.g. Scala, Python, Java, C# etc.) and understand both domain modelling and application programming.
You have working knowledge of data management platforms (SQL, NoSQL, Spark/Databricks etc.)
You have working knowledge of modern software engineering tools (Git, CI/CD pipelines), cloud technologies (Azure, AWS) and IaC (e.g. Terraform, Pulumi)
You have worked with different frameworks throughout technology stacks (e.g. React/Angular/Vue/Blazor frontends etc., FastAPI/Spring Boot/Django/.NET backends etc.)
You have experience building and working across different architectural approaches, and are confident in justifying your technology and architectural choices.
You are passionate about communicating complex concepts succinctly to both technical and non-technical colleagues and clients to reach a common understanding.
You have experience working with agile methodologies (e.g. Scrum/Kanban), with an understanding of the key principles that underpin its effective use.

We’ve seen the research that says that some candidates will not apply to a role if they don’t meet every requirement, so don’t let this put you off. If you think you are a good overall match please do get in touch – we look carefully at all applications and you may well be our ideal candidate.

What a career at Baringa will give you

Putting People First.

Benefits

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include:

Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service.
Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave.
Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us.
Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice.
Profit Share Scheme: All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success.

Diversity and Inclusion

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people.

An award-winning workplace

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. Click here to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this.

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer | Enterprise | Full-Stack
jobs.description:
EngRadar / DeepL

Senior Software Engineer | Enterprise | Full-Stack

DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems, offering a Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing, and real-time voice translation.

DeepL
is the employer — EngRadar is a job radar, not a recruiter. We track this posting from their own careers page and send you straight there; we never handle applications or CVs.

Remote London Full-time Posted today aitranslation

Apply directly →

Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.

Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What Sets Us Apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication
. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.

You will join the Business Acceleration Track (BAT)
. This is the engine room of DeepL’s global growth. While our Research teams build the models, BAT builds the Revenue Flywheel
that allows 200,000+ Enterprises (like the Fortune 500) to actually use and pay for them at scale .

We are moving upmarket. We are transitioning from a consumer-focused app to a mission-critical Enterprise Platform. You will be part of the team architecting the "Financial Nervous System" of DeepL — handling everything from Identity & Access Management (SSO, SCIM) to complex multi-seat Subscription Architectures and Fraud Prevention .

We don't hire engineers to just implement UI tickets. We hire Missionaries
who understand that a perfect AI model is useless if a Global Enterprise can't provision it securely to 50,000 employees. You will own the full vertical: from the user-facing Admin Console in React to the distributed billing logic in C#/.NET.

Your Responsibilities

Architect Revenue-Critical Flows: You will design and ship complex, high-stakes features like "Enterprise Licensing" or "Automated Seat Provisioning." You ensure that when a customer upgrades, the UX is instant, and the billing ledger is immutable.
Own the "Enterprise Experience": You will build the tools that empower CIOs and IT Directors to manage DeepL. You translate complex backend constraints (RBAC, Rate Limits) into simple, elegant UI workflows.
Bridge the Gap: You are bilingual in "Engineering" and "Business." You work directly with Sales, Product, and Finance to translate "Annual Recurring Revenue" goals into scalable technical architectures .
Drive System Reliability: You understand that billing systems cannot fail. You build for idempotency and resilience, ensuring that our financial data is auditable and flawless, while maintaining a high-velocity frontend experience.

Qualities we look for

A "Product-First" Mindset: You care deeply about the customer journey. You ask, "How does this feature help us close the next Enterprise deal?" before writing code.
Full-Stack Fluency: You are comfortable traversing the stack. You can design a React component for an Admin Dashboard in the morning and debug a distributed transaction in the backend in the afternoon.
Enterprise Domain Curiosity: You are interested in the hard problems of B2B SaaS—Identity (SAML/SSO), Monetization, and Compliance. You understand that these aren't "boring details"; they are the pillars of trust for enterprise clients .
High Agency: You don't wait for permission. If the billing reconciliation process is slow, you automate it. If the documentation for the API is unclear, you fix it.
AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like GitHub Copilot or Claude) to accelerate your velocity and eliminate repetitive toil. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving.

A Note on Our Hiring Process:
DeepL hires for the Company
, not just a specific team. We operate a Unified Engineering Pipeline
. If you pass our bar, we will match you to the highest-priority role that fits your skillset—whether that is in Core Product, Platform, Voice, or Enterprise. We prioritize "Missionaries" who want to solve the biggest problems, wherever they live in the stack .

What We Offer

Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.
Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.
Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

jobs.description:
Job Context

Engineering

Leeds
Full-Time
Hybrid

Are you a people-first engineering leader who thrives on turning complex technical challenges into elegant, user-centric software?

As our Senior Engineering Manager, you will sit at the intersection of high-level business strategy and hands-on execution. You will lead the engineering organisation responsible for the full BigChange product suite—from our legacy monolith to our rapidly evolving microservices architecture and mobile product ecosystem.

Reporting to executive leadership, you will lead high-performing development teams, translate strategic vision into actionable technical roadmaps, and embed an AI-first engineering culture that elevates delivery velocity, code quality, and team capabilities.

About BigChange:

BigChange is at an inflection point. As a pioneer of AI-powered field service software serving over 250,000 users worldwide, we are transforming how trades and field service businesses operate. Headquartered in Leeds and part of the global Simpro Group network, our platform connects jobs, people, and performance across plumbing, HVAC, fire & security, facilities management, electrical contracting, and more.

Trusted by over 2,200 high-growth businesses, we've processed billions in invoiced work and scheduled tens of millions of jobs. We've featured multiple times on the Sunday Times Tech Track 100, and we're just getting started. We’ve recently launched BigChange Lightning—an AI intelligence layer that deploys autonomous agents across field service operations—and we are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the teams building what comes next.

What You’ll Do

People Leadership & Talent Development

Grow & Mentor: Run regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and merit cycles, providing honest, constructive feedback and creating tangible career pathways for individual contributors and leaders alike.
Build a High-Trust Culture: Drive hiring, onboarding, and retention efforts in Leeds to foster an inclusive, collaborative environment where engineers feel motivated to stay and do their best work.
Be a Pillar of Support: Act as a trusted sounding board and support system for your team through both professional and personal challenges.

Technical Requirements

Legacy Modernization & Strategy: Expertise in bridging legacy monoliths (.NET 4.6.2, WebForms, jQuery) with modern architecture (C# .NET 8, Micro-frontends, Microservices on AWS EKS).
Full-Stack Platform Management: Ability to lead diverse development streams across Web (React, WebForms), Mobile (iOS/Swift, Android/Kotlin, Kotlin Multiplatform), and Backend systems.
Cloud & DevOps Leadership: Proven experience managing cloud infrastructure (AWS EC2, EKS) and robust CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps.
Data Architecture: Proficiency in overseeing multi-model data environments, including relational (MS SQL, PG SQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB) databases, alongside data integration pipelines (Snowflake, FiveTran).
Observability & Security Integration: A proactive approach to system health (New Relic), security compliance (Snyk, Auth0), and incident management (PagerDuty, FlagSmith).

Technical & Mobile Platform Strategy

Set Technical Vision: Establish and communicate a technical vision that aligns with business goals, making pragmatic architectural decisions across web, cloud, and mobile platforms.
Platform Evolution: Oversee our continued migration from an AWS EC2 monolith toward AWS EKS microservices, ensuring system reliability, security, and long-term scalability.
Mobile Ecosystem Leadership: Drive high technical standards across our native and cross-platform mobile apps, mastering the nuances of mobile performance, deployment, and app store ecosystems.
Champion Engineering Excellence: Establish high standards for code quality, continuous testing, and proactive management of technical debt with an AI-first lens.

Delivery, Operations & AI-First SDLC

Transform to an AI-First Team: Lead the transition from traditional agile delivery to an AI-first software development lifecycle—leveraging developer tooling and CI/CD intelligence to fundamentally change how engineers work and what they achieve.
Measure Progress: Utilize industry-standard framework metrics (such as DX Core 4) to track team performance, remove delivery bottlenecks, and validate the efficiency gains of our AI transformation.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with Product Management, Commercial teams, and executive leadership to balance feature delivery (especially mobile-first initiatives) with platform maintenance and technical debt.
Incident & Vendor Leadership: Take the lead during high-priority technical incidents, coordinating calm, swift resolutions, while managing key vendor relationships and external software partnerships where required.

What You’ll Bring

Proven Engineering Leadership: 8+ years of total software engineering experience with a track record of successfully managing, scaling, and transforming engineering teams within a fast-paced SaaS environment.
Mobile & Systems Architecture Depth: Hands-on expertise in modern mobile application development (iOS, Android, React Native, or Flutter) alongside proven experience navigating hybrid environments combining legacy systems and cloud microservices.
AI Conviction: Genuine conviction about AI in engineering—you've moved teams beyond AI as a curiosity to AI as a core capability multiplier in developer workflows and product features.
Pragmatic Debt Navigator: A track record of navigating legacy systems and technical debt pragmatically without stalling product velocity or feature delivery.
Executive Communicator: Strong presence and communication skills—you easily translate complex technical challenges for executive stakeholders and bridge the gap between technical and business goals.
Empathetic Leader: A genuinely people-first manager who takes team morale, psychological safety, and individual growth seriously.
Location: Located in or able to regularly commute to our headquarters in Leeds for on-site leadership presence.

Our Core Values

We Are One Team

We Are Customer Centric

We Are Growth Minded

We Are Accountable

We Celebrate Success

Simpro, AroFlo, BigChange & ClockShark are equal opportunity employers with a best-of-class onboarding program and supportive team environments. This means that we want everyone to feel welcome and offer equal opportunities for everyone, regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation, or any other non-performance factor.

If you'd like to join a fun and progressive organisation, where there are opportunities to develop your career, please apply now with your CV/Resumer.

Please note: no agencies will be accepted in the recruitment of this role. Any CVs provided to Simpro Software by agencies will be treated as a gift.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalized than ever before.  Learn more at geniussports.com.  

The Role

You will join one of our established high-performing teams within the Betting division, as we invest in our core and future Betting products. You will be focusing on the delivery of technical and product-focused initiatives, to expand and scale up our industry's leading Sportsbook and Risk Management products.

One example is our Advanced Risk team, who were set up to challenge conventional wisdom about risk management for sports betting operators. Using new measures of liability that take account of correlations between different markets on an event, and by monitoring betting patterns from the moment an event is opened for betting, we apply margins asymmetrically in a way that helps operators to make higher profit margins, reduce volatility and improve customer experience with greater uptime and fewer rejected bets. Our software provides customers with a new level of flexibility over the way they manage their Sportsbooks to meet their financial objectives. Smart algorithms allow decisions about bets to be taken quickly at scale while enabling close control when desired, reminiscent of earlier days of sports betting.

How will you work?

Join a specially formed, highly skilled team delivering an innovative & intelligent product! Forming part of a multi-disciplinary Agile team of Software Engineers, Data Scientists, QA Engineers and a Product Manager, you will look to work closely to the fundamental principles of continuous delivery and empowered, high-performing teams.

We operate in a squad model to allow focus on the business top priorities, allowing exposure across multiple products while still maintaining strong ownership of your team’s domain.

If you are looking to tackle hard problems with smart solutions, collaborate with astute engineers and deliver high calibre code with an autonomous & performance focused approach that supports success, delivery & quality, then this is for you.

As a Senior Software Engineer 1 (SR1) you and your team will build highly distributed, real-time, dynamically scaling systems using modern CI/CD pipelines & cloud infrastructure. You will be responsible for innovating, architecting, delivering & maintaining an industry-revolutionising product. You will lead execution of multi-sprint features or systems with measurable business impact.

We will lean on your technical expertise and your pragmatic approach to problem solving; working in a team that prioritises the principles of Agile delivery and continuous improvement. You will have a Data-driven, evidence-based mentality, comfortable with the principles of continuous experimentation and validation.

What skills do you have?

You will have expert level knowledge of at least one object-oriented programming language (C#, Java, JS, Kotlin, Python, PHP, Golang, C++)
Flexibility to work on all areas of the service stack, front-end, back-end, infrastructure etc.
You will have a strong understanding of the principles of good software design. Familiarity with core concepts such as information hiding, abstraction, module design, cohesion and coupling.
You will have strong software architecture knowledge, including architectural patterns and how to apply them to highly-scalable, fault-tolerant, observable microservices and systems.
You will have detailed knowledge of testing methodology (TDD) and designing high-quality testing suites resilient to changes in implementation.
You will have experience of source control, continuous integration, pipeline design, containerised workloads and infrastructure as code.
You will have experience in messaging and asynchronous communication technologies (RabbitMQ, Pulsar)
Understanding of Data Structures, Databases and Caching Technologies
You bring clarity to complex domains, rapidly developing a deep understanding and challenging unclear requirements. You lead conversations that drive alignment and uncover edge cases others might miss.
You will have experience in mentoring engineers both within and outside the immediate team.

It is advantageous for you to have knowledge of the following:

You will have expert knowledge of C#
Operation of Kubernetes Clusters
Building cloud native applications (AWS)
Front-end web technologies (React, shadcn)
Domain Driven Design
Mathematical Aptitude, particularly statistics
Data Engineering skills
Experience in building production grade software with Agentic AI

What We Expect From Our Co-workers

Curiosity and strong desire to learn and improve.
Social skills, being able to act as a facilitator, can balance enabling others with individual contributions.
Time management and asynchronous communication skills relevant for a remote-first engineering organization.
Enthusiasm and ability to work collaboratively within a team.
Excellent spoken and written English.
Adherence to our core engineering principles of Aligned Autonomy, Psychological Safety and Continuous Improvement.

We enjoy an ‘office-first’ culture and maximize opportunities to collaborate, connect and learn together. Our hybrid working models differ depending on your role and location. Occasional travel may be required.

As well as a competitive salary and range of benefits, we’re committed to supporting employee wellbeing and helping you grow your skills, experience and career. Learn more about how rewarding life at Genius can be at Reward | Genius Sports. One team, being brave, driving change 

We strive to create an inclusive working environment, where everyone feels a sense of belonging and the ability to make a difference. Learn more about our values and culture at Culture | Genius Sports.

How We Work:

Delta Capita is an equal opportunity employer. We positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of age, colour, disability, national origin, ancestry, race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Description

Would you like to help drive the growth and technical software delivery expertise of a global company that works with 91% of the Fortune Global 500? Are you an experienced engineer who is fluent with the latest AI and agentic tooling, thrives on AI agent-led delivery, and can think on your feet to propose innovative solutions to challenging problems? If so, we have an exciting opportunity to join our Willis Neuron Technology team in the UK.

This is an exceptional opportunity to play a key role in developing the change capabilities of a global financial services organisation, where our delivery model is pivoting towards AI agent-led development, and the focus is on practical delivery and reacting to the highest value business needs.

You will hit the ground running: building AI-enabled products with large language models and modern agent frameworks and directing AI coding assistants to deliver at pace. You will turn concepts from our architects and product managers into working software quickly, challenge technical design and delivery choices, and bring the analytical rigour needed to take AI solutions safely into production.

The Role

Design, build and productionise AI-enabled features and services using large language models, RAG, prompt engineering and agent frameworks / orchestration (such as LangChain, LangGraph or Semantic Kernel).
Take AI solutions beyond prototype, owning evaluation, testing, guardrails, observability, security and cost management.
Rapidly prototype and validate ideas, turning concepts into working software within days and proving out how to build the solution properly at scale.
Deliver hands-on development of class leading web-based applications and services, integrating AI capabilities with our existing platform (C# / .NET, React and/or Angular, Python) and our Azure cloud and DevOps tooling.
Direct AI coding assistants and agentic workflows (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) alongside your own hands-on expertise, and rigorously review both human-written and AI-generated code against our architectural, development and security standards.
Own delivery of a small suite of business-related projects, ensuring architectural and solution alignment with the wider technical vision.
Drive adoption of AI agent-led delivery across the team, coaching others in effective and responsible use of AI tooling so the capability spreads.
Challenge established development processes and procedures, particularly how AI agents are integrated into the SDLC, and work closely with the Engineering Leads on tooling adoption and delivery outcomes.
Track AI and agentic technology trends outside the organisation and apply them pragmatically to our products, whilst developing deep domain knowledge.

Qualifications

What you’ll bring

Essential Experience

Practical experience building with AI and agentic technologies: large language models, RAG, prompt engineering, and agent frameworks / orchestration (such as LangChain, LangGraph or Semantic Kernel).
Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants and agentic development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) in a professional delivery setting, and the ability to critically review, validate and secure the code they produce.
Strong hands-on software engineering experience (minimum 10 years commercial), with React and/or Angular, TypeScript, C# / .NET and Python.
Hands-on commercial experience in Azure cloud, using GitHub and Azure DevOps, across all phases of the SDLC and Agile delivery.
Proven ability to rapidly prototype and validate ideas, moving a concept from whiteboard to working demo in days.
Demonstrable experience leading, influencing and mentoring through hands-on contributions.
Experience of working in a financial services organisation, preferably with exposure to the insurance industry / insurance broking. Where this directly relevant experience is not available, we will be looking for an ability to rapidly become effective in a new, unfamiliar environment.
First-rate communication skills, applied to rapid and creative problem solving with technical and business stakeholders in an occasionally pressurised environment.
Comfortable working on your own initiative or as part of a broader project team, remotely or face to face, and confident challenging established approaches.

Desirable Experience

Experience running AI / LLM solutions in production at scale, including evaluation frameworks, guardrails and cost management.
Experience designing or orchestrating multi-agent workflows, and familiarity with agent protocols (e.g. MCP) for integrating AI agents with engineering pipelines and enterprise data.
Experience with microservice based architectures and containerisation.
Experience building and working with mathematical algorithms, or with geospatial, catastrophe or financial-modelling data.
Experience understanding and translating complex business processes across multiple stakeholder groups.
BSc degree qualified in a quantitative discipline (Mathematics, Science or Computer Science).

The role offers hybrid working with travel to office expected on a regular cadence for meetings and workshops. Some occasional travel may be required as part of the engagement with business and technology stakeholders.

What We Offer

Enjoy a benefits package designed to help you thrive, both professionally and personally. You'll receive 25 days of annual leave plus an extra WTW day to relax and recharge. Our comprehensive health and wellbeing offering includes private healthcare, life insurance, group income protection, and regular health assessments, all giving you peace of mind. Secure your future with our defined contribution pension scheme, featuring matched contributions up to 10% from the company.

We support your growth and balance with hybrid working options, access to an employee assistance programme, and a fully paid volunteer day to make a difference in your community. On top of these, you can opt into a variety of additional perks including an electric vehicle car scheme, share scheme, cycle-to-work programme, dental and optical cover, critical illness protection, and much more. Start making the most of your career and wellbeing with a range of benefits tailored for you.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We’re committed to equal employment opportunity and provide application, interview and workplace adjustments and accommodations to all applicants. If you foresee any barriers, from the application process through to joining WTW, please email candidatehelpdesk@wtwco.com

jobs.title: Summer Internship 2027 - Software Engineering & Innovation
jobs.description:
Software Engineering & Innovation Summer Internship 2027 (June - August)

A summer at Baillie Gifford could transform your career before it even starts. As an independent global investment management business, we rely on technology to underpin everything we do. That’s why we constantly invest in our technology and the team of professionals who bring it to life. Join us as a summer intern and show us what you can do!

What can you expect

You’ll be immersed in our technology environment from the word go on our paid summer internship. Expect to do real work and take responsibility as you gain hands-on experience with our technologies in an AI-native environment. You can look forward to being part of a refreshingly open, cooperative, and supportive team culture. Plus, you will get the training and support to broaden your skills and discover your future potential, from LinkedIn Learning, to Pluralsight and peer-to-peer working, a summer with us will transform your skillset and CV!

Interns will be placed into cohorts, working on different live technical projects aligned to either our Application Development and Enablement Department or our Innovation Department. While the projects and technologies used will vary, all cohorts will gain exposure to emerging technologies, including AI and large language models (LLMs), and will have opportunities to explore how these tools are applied across our technology teams. Which team and project our interns will land in will depend on business needs.

Our Software Engineers create scalable applications and solutions that drive our business and make it smarter for the future. We’ll introduce you to our modern programming languages, cloud platforms and DevOps practices and show you how software engineering shapes the future of investment management. You’ll have the opportunity to touch a wide range of tech, possibly including .NET, Angular, Azure Service Bus, Docker and Microservices Architecture, to name a few, as well as getting to grips with Agile methodologies in a business setting.

Within our R&D team, our Engineers push the boundaries of what is possible with disruptive tech and grapple with deeply interesting problems. They work with a broad range of technologies, including Python and platforms such as PyTorch, TensorFlow and Hugging Face, as well as Gen AI, LLMs, CI/CD, containerisation and cloud.

You’ll discover how technology drives the business forward in the fast-evolving investment management industry. Irrespective of which department you land in, you’ll be exposed to emerging tech and new ideas.

Your internship will start with structured overviews that introduce you to our business. Following induction, you and your fellow interns will work together within your cohort on a live technical project for the firm. We’ll ensure you spend quality time with our experienced technical and business leads, who will share their knowledge and support you throughout the process. You can expect to get hands-on with the latest tools and approaches in AI – from working with large language models to building agentic workflows and intelligent systems.

Running alongside your project, you will have various development opportunities with other teams in our technical departments to ensure broad exposure to the range of careers possible in tech. During your first weeks, you will build relationships and learn about the tech we use, which will feel very different to the learning opportunities that university life provides.

This won’t be a passive learning experience; you’ll be contributing to real outcomes, collaborating closely with experienced engineers and subject matter experts, and learning by doing. There will be plenty of opportunities to grow your skills and make a tangible impact.

If your cohort completes its core project ahead of schedule, you’ll be encouraged to proactively seek out further opportunities to contribute across your team or department. With support from colleagues, you’ll be able to explore work that aligns with your interests and development goals while responding to the priorities and needs of the business.

The type of Candidate that we’re looking for

A penultimate (second last) year student studying for a technology-related degree, with a proven interest in software engineering, cloud native development & automation and/or GenAI/ML and experimentation.
A passion for technology, we’re looking for people who have a genuine interest in how we can harness the benefits of technology to impact everything we do positively.
A desire to learn requires a thirst for learning and a willingness to embrace challenges.
Great relationship and networking skills – the internship involves building strong relationships and working collaboratively across teams, so you’ll need to be able to work with a range of people at all levels and operate effectively whilst outside of your technical comfort zone.
Critical thinking, you will enjoy problem-solving, we’re looking for people who enjoy working with complex scenarios and can collaborate with others to deliver a project successfully, always asking ‘why?’
Resilient by nature and comfortable working in a fluid environment, where ambiguity and emerging tech collide, where technical creativity and ‘what if’ go together.

Critical Skills

Adaptability
Digital Effectiveness (incl.AI)
Team Working
Systems Thinking
Improvement Mindset
Nurturing Relationships

You can apply for only one of our two
internship programmes, so please carefully consider which programme most closely aligns with your career aspirations.

To apply, you will share your CV and answer one scored question. We encourage you to carefully consider your answer to the scored question so that it demonstrates your way of thinking and feels authentic to you.

Should you choose to use AI tools to support your application, we ask that you do this thoughtfully. We encourage you to ensure your application reflects your own voice, experience, and motivations. We value authenticity and want to understand your individual strengths and perspectives. In turn, Baillie Gifford does not use any AI in our recruitment processes.

Please note that, due to the programme's short-term nature, Baillie Gifford cannot sponsor visas. All applicants must have the right to work in the UK to be considered for the programmes. Our internship is based in Edinburgh and, due to its short duration, is an on-site opportunity. You must be comfortable being based in Edinburgh for the entire duration, between mid-June and late August, and sourcing your own accommodation in the Edinburgh area, if you are not based locally or within a commutable distance.

The project(s) and team our interns join are determined by business demands at the time of onboarding. No guarantee is provided regarding the specific technical team interns join.

November 3, 2026

We are looking for software and systems engineers to help design, deliver and support the next generation of aerospace test facilities globally with a main focus testing of software developed by the team. The Rolls-Royce Measurement & Test Engineering organisation are responsible for designing and delivering the infrastructure required to test the next generation of gas turbine engines for both Civil and Defence applications. This includes Test Bed 80, the world’s largest indoor aerospace test bed.

Why join Rolls-Royce?

At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere.

By joining Rolls-Royce, you'll have the opportunity to work on world-class solutions, supported by a culture that believes individuality is our greatest strength, and all perspectives, experiences and backgrounds help us innovate and enable our high-performance culture.

The Experimental Systems team are responsible for delivering a wide range of measurement and control system technologies. The team have just completed the design, installation, and commissioning of all the data systems on Test Bed 80 from concept to first engine run and helped complete the first run on the UltraFan (our most instrumented engine ever).

The software design side of the team are responsible for developing bespoke applications to support the planning, conducting, monitoring, and reporting of engine tests and their data. They are also responsible for managing the IT infrastructure supporting the test facilities. Requirements capture and analysis, and the preparation of system specifications
Implement and drive cyber security best practices

You will have the confidence and ability to work as part of a team and take the lead on technical projects. Software testing and test automation

Experience in Dev Ops and Agile work practices

You will have a demonstrable track record of delivering under pressure to both tight and changing project deadlines. Highly self-motivated and enthusiastic, you will be able to produce work of a consistently high standard.

Intapp is looking for a Client Support Engineer to join our Client Success & Support team. This is a technical, client-facing role focused on the investigation and resolution of issues across Intapp Time — our time capture and management platform — in both cloud and on-premise environments.

What you'll do

Own investigation, triage, and resolution of client-reported issues across Intapp Profitability, with a primary focus on Intapp Time in cloud and on-premise environments.

Diagnose issues across the Intapp Time ecosystem, including the web application, Admin, Desktop, Desktop Extension, Mobile, Capture, tenant configuration, and identity and access management.

Investigate common support scenarios such as time-entry and submission failures, missing client or matter data, validation and synchronisation issues, performance problems, login failures, and integration errors.

Use logs, error messages, configuration, browser diagnostics, API responses, and client-provided evidence to isolate root cause and distinguish product defects from configuration, data, network, or environmental issues.

Troubleshoot integrations between Intapp Time and clients' practice-management or financial-management systems using SQL, stored procedures, SOAP/REST APIs, data mappings, service accounts, and integration logs.

Support issues involving Intapp Integration Service (Dell Boomi) and Intapp Integrate, including schedules, connectors, mappings, credentials, queues, and process reporting.

Apply impact-based triage and prioritisation, taking account of production availability, affected users, business impact, and service-level expectations, and act promptly on high-priority or widespread issues.

Provide accurate, timely, and technically clear updates to client contacts, translating complex findings into practical next steps and maintaining ownership through to resolution.

Prepare complete escalation packages for product defects, including business impact, diagnostic evidence, steps to reproduce, and relevant logs.

Recognise when a request falls outside break-fix support and route it to the appropriate team while maintaining a smooth client handover.

Maintain accurate, audit-ready ticket records and contribute to knowledge articles and troubleshooting guides that improve consistency and time to resolution.

What you'll need

2+ years' experience supporting enterprise SaaS and/or on-premise software in a client-facing technical support or application support role.

Experience supporting integrations between enterprise business applications.

Practical experience with ticketing systems and support workflows, including impact-based prioritisation, SLA management, and accurate technical documentation.

Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to investigate complex symptoms, interpret logs, and identify root cause.

Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL; Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL experience is highly desirable.

Working knowledge of SOAP and REST APIs, HTTP, authentication, JSON/XML payloads, and common integration or connectivity issues.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical client contacts.

Experience supporting Intapp Time, other Intapp Profitability products, Intapp Integration Service (Dell Boomi), or Intapp Integrate.

Familiarity with Microsoft technologies such as .NET, Internet Information Services (IIS), Windows Server, PowerShell, or SQL Server, or relevant Microsoft, .NET, or SQL certification.

Experience with identity and access technologies such as SSO, SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, or Microsoft Entra ID.

Familiarity with API testing tools such as Postman or browser developer tools.

Experience creating knowledge-base content or support procedures that reduce recurring issues and improve resolution quality.

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started.

Location:

Remote (Europe)

How You'll Make an Impact:

As a Staff Software Engineer
in Revenue Intelligence, you will shape the technical direction of systems that help hospitality businesses understand demand, identify revenue opportunities, and make better pricing and commercial decisions. You will work across customer-facing applications, backend services, data pipelines, analytical stores, recommendation workflows, and cloud infrastructure. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will solve complex engineering problems directly while establishing architecture, improving reliability and security, reducing systemic technical debt, and aligning multiple teams around durable technical decisions. Your impact will extend beyond individual features to the quality, scalability, operability, and long-term evolution of the Revenue Intelligence platform.

Our Revenue Intelligence Team:

The Revenue Intelligence team builds products and platforms that turn hospitality data into practical decisions for hoteliers, including pricing recommendations, demand insights, reporting, automation, and commercial opportunities. Our systems span frontend experiences, APIs, distributed services, data processing, machine-learning workflows, and production infrastructure. We value pragmatic engineering, strong ownership, evidence-based decisions, and technical leaders who raise the effectiveness of the people and systems around them.

What You Bring to the Team:

Set and evolve the technical strategy for Revenue Intelligence, translating product and business goals into coherent architecture and executable engineering plans
Lead the design and delivery of complex capabilities across customer-facing web applications, backend APIs, event-driven services, data pipelines, analytical storage, and recommendation workflows
Identify and resolve systemic risks in scalability, reliability, security, data quality, observability, and operability before they become recurring customer or engineering problems
Drive modernization of legacy systems and infrastructure through incremental, well-reasoned migrations that preserve delivery momentum and production stability
Partner with Product, Data Science, Infrastructure, Security, and engineering leaders to define boundaries, contracts, ownership, and long-term platform direction
Remain hands-on in the codebase through implementation, technical spikes, design reviews, debugging, incident response, and the most consequential or ambiguous engineering work
Raise the technical effectiveness of the wider organization through mentoring, architecture guidance, engineering standards, documentation, and constructive challenge

What Sets You Up for Success:

10+ years of software engineering experience, including significant technical leadership across complex production systems
Deep hands-on expertise in Python, with the ability to work effectively across both ecosystems and guide engineering decisions beyond a single language
Strong architecture and distributed-systems fundamentals, including API design, event-driven workflows, consistency, failure handling, scalability, and service boundaries
Experience with data-intensive systems such as PostgreSQL, Redshift, or similar analytical platforms, batch and streaming pipelines, and large-scale data processing
Experience designing or operating recommendation systems, machine-learning platforms, pricing systems, experimentation workflows, or other decision-support products
Strong cloud and platform engineering experience across AWS, containers, Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm, Argo CD, CI/CD, observability, and secure production operations
A demonstrated ability to lead through influence, create alignment across teams, communicate complex tradeoffs clearly, and drive decisions from ambiguity to execution
A strong record of improving engineering quality through testing strategy, operational readiness, incident learning, security, documentation, and sustainable technical standards
Product judgment and customer empathy, with the ability to connect technical investments to measurable outcomes for hoteliers and the business
Business-level English fluency and experience collaborating effectively in a remote, globally distributed organization

Bonus Skills to Stand Out:

Deep hands-on expertise in .NET/C#

What to Expect - Your Journey with Us

Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team of redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ employees across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle.

Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary.
Learn more online at cloudbeds.com

Company Awards:

Best All-In-One Hotel Management System | HotelTechAwards (2025)
Overall 10 Best Places to Work | HotelTechAwards (2025)
Most Loved Workplace® Certified (2024)
Top 10 People’s Choice (2024)
Deloitte Technology Fast 500 (2024)

Remote First, Remote Always
PTO in accordance with local labor requirements
Monthly Wellness Fridays - enjoy an extra-long weekend every month
Fully Paid Parental Leave
Home office stipend based on country of residency

Everyone is Welcome - A Culture of Inclusion

Cloudbeds is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer that celebrates the diversity in our global team! We welcome applications from all backgrounds and particularly encourage interest from women, underrepresented groups, and neurodivergent candidates. Due to the nature of the work and the customers we support, the successful candidate must be eligible to meet UK Government and contractual personnel security requirements, including the applicable residency requirements for the role, and have the right to work in the United Kingdom. Enthusiasm for collaboration and excellent communication skills (written and verbal).
An interest in keeping up with emerging tools, techniques, and technologies.
Effective time management and organisational skills.
A flexible and Agile way of working within a fast paced and everchanging environment.
Attention to detail with a pragmatic and enthusiastic attitude to work.

Desirable Skills And Technologies

Experience and knowledge of AWS / Azure and Azure Virtual Desktop.
Proficiency in the following languages: Python, React, Go.

Experience of Test Driven or Behaviour Driven development.
