jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Git Systems
jobs.description:
About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, United Kingdom

Overview

GitHub is seeking a Staff Software Engineer
to join the Git Systems Engineering team, which runs the largest code-hosting platform in the world, part of our Platform and Infrastructure organization. Our group is responsible for the services that store and serve Git repositories, both directly to users and to other layers in the GitHub software stack. We build the various microservices, protocols, proxies, and control systems that power Git operations at GitHub and operate them at scale.

You will work on real-world, large-scale distributed systems and help design, build, and support highly available, performant, and scalable services that enable the next generation of AI-driven software development by improving Git code-hosting platform through wide-reaching, cross-team work.

Our group is highly distributed and the right candidate will thrive in an environment of asynchronous communication. We expect you to have excellent written communication skills and be able to create working relationships with coworkers in locations around the globe.

Prior experience solving problems with large-scale, distributed systems is preferred.

(i.e. Petabytes of storage, millions of objects, low latency, high throughput with millions of QPS)

Responsibilities

Design, develop, test, and ship high-quality technical solutions that scale across multiple GitHub services; build deep familiarity with the systems you own; and write maintainable code.
Document architectural designs and proposals, run targeted experiments, and validate approaches with prototypes.
Lead by example and mentor others to produce extensible and maintainable code used across products and integrated with downstream dependencies.
Provide technical leadership through code reviews for solutions and product areas to ensure quality standards are met, while designing for high availability and GitHub-scale performance.
Coordinate with engineering and product owners to define, prioritize, and deliver projects to meet business goals.
Maintain operations of live services as issues arise on a rotational, on-call basis. Implement and support others to build solutions and mitigations to complex issues impacting the performance or functionality of Live Site services.
Cultivate an environment where team members are empowered and demonstrate a strong sense of ownership and belonging.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

9+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python
OR Associate’s Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 8+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python
OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field AND 7+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python
OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 5+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python
OR Doctorate in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 3+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python
OR equivalent experience.

Who We Are
At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.
We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team.
Our Values
If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.
Who You Are
You are self-driven and like to work with others to remove roadblocks. You are curious and love to explore and learn new technologies. You have demonstrated the ability to build, deploy, and maintain large-scale, complex applications. You care more about solutions and impacting the customer experience than using a particular tool or framework.
About the role:

You will join a small, highly autonomous cross-functional team to build AI agents that fundamentally transform how operations work at scale. Instead of writing bespoke software for every workflow, we are developing an agent platform that can read operational knowledge, reason about it in context, and execute tasks end-to-end. This approach allows us to scale complexity through knowledge and reasoning, rather than simply through code.
This is an opportunity to join a foundational team, which currently consists of fewer than five engineers. The work spans critical areas including LLM-powered agent design, robust backend service architecture, tool and integration development, and sophisticated knowledge infrastructure.
We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with a strong passion for building AI-native systems in a product environment. The ideal candidate will be able to take ownership of large segments of the technology stack, make pragmatic technical decisions in ambiguous and emerging territory, and consistently ship high-quality, production-ready systems that our users rely on every day.
Responsibilities:

Design, build, and own core components of the agent platform, from the orchestration layer to the tool integrations connecting it to internal systems.
Build and evolve the capabilities layer: APIs, data access patterns, and service integrations for agents to execute operational workflows.
Architect the knowledge and memory infrastructure, allowing agents to retrieve the data and act across our systems.
Design and implement the trust and safety framework, including audit trails, human-in-the-loop controls, and guardrails for safe and auditable AI-driven operations.
Contribute to agent evaluation and testing infrastructure, defining how we measure accuracy, reliability, and regression across agent behaviors.
Partner directly with Operations to understand workflows, identify automation opportunities, and translate process knowledge into agent capabilities.
Mentor other engineers on the team as it grows.

About the candidate

You are comfortable in a fast-paced, early-stage environment.

You demonstrate a "scrappy" and resourceful approach, proactively identifying solutions and unblocking yourself without needing a fully defined path.
You are pragmatic and balance quality with speed.

You understand when to optimize for long-term durability and when to iterate quickly. You prioritize pragmatism over being overly precious about code, but never compromise on quality in a way that creates future issues.
You are product-minded.

You look beyond the immediate task, seeking to understand the "why" behind the build and questioning whether it's the right product solution. You are comfortable contributing product thinking alongside engineering work.
You demonstrate a strong ownership mindset.

You are proactive, identify gaps, and drive initiatives to completion without waiting for explicit instructions. When encountering issues or ambiguity, you address them directly.
You possess strong backend engineering fundamentals.

You can confidently design, build, and operate production systems.
You are curious and eager to develop expertise in AI and LLMs.

While deep research is not required, you are motivated to build practical, real-world products using these tools, specifically focusing on agent systems.

Qualifications
5+ years of backend engineering experience building and operating production systems
Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI agents (orchestration, RAG, tool/function calling, or similar)
Strong API design and system integration skills
Product-minded: questions requirements and contributes to product decisions, not just execution
Proven ownership of complex projects in ambiguous, early-stage environments

Technologies Used
Golang, Ruby on Rails, Javascript, Java, C#, Python, VueJS, MySQL, Kafka, AWS, Git, Memcache, Redis, ElasticSearch, Docker, Terraform, Kubernetes, CircleCI, DataDog

The base wage range for this position based in The United Kingdom is targeted at 132,000-170,000 GBP per year.

Actual compensation is based on multiple factors that are unique to each candidate, including and not limited to skill set, level of relevant experience, and specific work location.  Salary ranges for positions based in other locations may differ based on the cost of labor in that location.

jobs.description:
At Longshot Systems we build advanced platforms for sports betting analytics and trading.

We're looking for a Software Engineer to join the team that owns and develops our trading platform. Longshot is a small, focused company and so the role suits someone who can architect and implement whatever is needed to meet our next product, performance or stability goal. The team owns the technical standards and coding guidelines, CI/CD, observability and security. This role suits someone who wants to ship features and contribute to the wider technical excellence in the team and platform.

The trading platform at Longshot handles integrations with many bookmakers and exchanges worldwide. It normalises and combines the global odds data for many sports and makes it available internally for strategies to trade on. We handle thousands of odds updates and trades per second and have very strict bounds on latency, correctness and overall quality of the feed and trading. You would be at the heart of this team: integrating more trading venues, optimising key parts of the platform, making trading safer and faster, etc. We also maintain a significant historical data repository and support wider trading and research efforts around the company.

Our key platform systems are all in Golang, with message buses and databases at the core of the architecture. You don't need to be fluent in Golang, but it would help. It's easy to learn and we have a team full of experts able to teach you.

We are a hybrid working company, working Thursdays in our London (Farringdon) office and flexible the rest of the week. Our typical working hours are 10 am to 6 pm UK time, Monday to Friday, but we support flexible working and trust our team to manage their own schedules to meet their goals.

Interview Process

Intro call (30 mins) - your background + interests
1st Technical interview (30 mins) - live code review & pair programming
2nd Technical interview (60 mins) - deep dive technical questions
Full assessment day (10:30-5pm) - a one day systems programming exercise designed to be similar to the real work we do in the team. Meet some of the team, see the office, have a nice lunch (on us)

Requirements

Bachelors or Masters in a quantitative or technical subject (e.g. Maths, EE, Physics, Comp Sci) from a top university
2+ years experience building mission critical distributed systems (finance, gaming, telco, ad-tech, etc.) where throughput, correctness and availability are a hard requirement
Proven track record delivering and maintaining production systems in at least one systems language (Go, C++, Rust, Java, C#, etc.), with clear, idiomatic designs
Startup experience: shipping products in small, fast moving teams
Architecture & design: Able to reason about trade offs and produce clean, evolvable service boundaries
Cloud & DevOps: comfortable working in AWS, linux and wrangling build pipelines. We have dedicated DevOps people, but you do need to be competent in the core skills here
Fluent written and spoken English. Communicating with the team is as important as the technical work. You need to be able to effectively collaborate on everything from low level details to long term strategic planning

Nice to have

Trading, market making or exchange experience

Participation in the uncapped company bonus scheme

Long term illness insurance
Gym membership

About This Role

Vice President, AI-Enabled Product Engineer – Aladdin, Investments & Trading Engineering

Location:
Edinburgh

About The Role

BlackRock is seeking a Vice President, AI-Enabled Product Engineer to join Aladdin, Investments & Trading Engineering within Analytics & Compliance Engineering. This role is for a hands-on engineering leader who can build scalable agentic solutions while helping accelerate the adoption of AI-enabled engineering practices across the product development lifecycle.

The successful candidate will work at the intersection of investment technology, investment compliance workflows, full-stack engineering, and applied AI. They will help design and deliver capabilities across the Aladdin platform that support investment professionals, compliance teams, and business stakeholders operating in complex global markets.

About Aladdin, Investments & Trading Engineering

Aladdin is BlackRock’s technology platform used by investment professionals to manage portfolios, analyse risk, execute workflows, and make decisions at scale. Within Investments & Trading Engineering, Analytics & Compliance Engineering develops technology that helps teams manage investment guidelines, regulatory obligations, analytics-driven workflows, and operational controls across global markets.

The Investment and Trading Compliance Engineering team is responsible for developing and maintaining tools to ensure that organizations using Aladdin® comply at different stages of the asset management process. This includes ensuring that clients follow guidelines established internally, by themselves, and by the market regulators. The system accomplishes this through high-throughput rule-based compliance engines, which sit at the heart of the investment system and process millions of calculations per day.

Our engineering teams build products with real reach, real complexity, and real impact. We are evolving our platform with persona-based, workflow-driven experiences, modular architecture, resilient services, and responsible AI capabilities that improve productivity, decision-making, knowledge discovery, and operational efficiency.

What You’ll Do

Design, build, and deliver high-quality full-stack Agnetic product capabilities across the Aladdin platform, with a focus on Analytics & Compliance Engineering workflows.
Act as a hands-on technical leader across the product development lifecycle, contributing to technical design, implementation, testing, deployment readiness, production support, and continuous improvement.
Partner with product managers, engineers, compliance specialists, and business stakeholders to translate complex business problems into clear specifications, technical designs, delivery plans, and actionable Agile backlogs.
Apply AI-enabled engineering practices to accelerate design exploration, prototyping, software development, testing, code review, documentation, and operational support.
Help embed responsible AI capabilities into product workflows and platform services, including intelligent assistants, workflow automation, semantic search, knowledge retrieval, and reasoning over compliance and investment information.
Build scalable, resilient, and operable systems that balance functional requirements with non-functional concerns such as performance, latency, reliability, security, observability, and maintainability.
Influence architecture and technical direction across initiatives, articulating design trade-offs and aligning stakeholders around pragmatic engineering choices.
Champion engineering excellence through test-driven development, behaviour-driven development, DevOps practices, production readiness, and an SRE mindset.
Mentor engineers, raise the bar for technical quality, and contribute to a culture of continuous learning, innovation, accountability, and collaboration across a global engineering organisation.

Qualifications

Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related STEM discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including experience delivering enterprise-scale systems in production.
Strong full-stack engineering background, with hands-on experience in modern backend and frontend technologies.
Proven ability to lead technical initiatives, shape ambiguous problem spaces, define execution plans, and deliver outcomes through collaboration with cross-functional partners.
Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, distributed systems, APIs, data flows, event-driven architecture, and resilient platform design.
Experience applying modern Agile, DevOps, and engineering excellence practices to improve delivery quality, team productivity, and operational outcomes.
Excellent communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Skills And Experience

Hands on experience with AI enabled SDLC / PDLC practices, including:
Using AI to accelerate design exploration, prototyping, and architectural decision making
Applying AI assisted development, testing, code review, and documentation practices
Embedding AI capabilities into product workflows and platform services responsibly and securely
Frameworks such as Devin / Windsurf, Cursor or GitHub Copilot
Hands-on full stack experience with Java or other modern backend languages, and frontend frameworks such as React or Angular.
Experience designing and operating APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and event-driven architectures at enterprise scale.
Exposure to Generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, semantic search, embeddings, knowledge retrieval, or agentic workflow patterns.
Strong focus on software quality, including automated testing, TDD, BDD, code review discipline, observability, resiliency, and production support.
Ability to reason about scalability, reliability, security, cost, maintainability, and delivery velocity when making technical decisions.
Experience working in large, global engineering organisations and collaborating across locations, time zones, product areas, and stakeholder groups.
Ability to build domain context quickly and translate investment, analytics, or compliance workflows into robust product and platform capabilities.

Preferred Experience

Experience in financial services, investment technology, compliance technology, regulatory technology, portfolio management, trading, or enterprise SaaS platforms.
Familiarity with compliance workflows, investment guidelines, rule intelligence, regulatory obligations, or controls-oriented technology.
Experience with cloud-native or hybrid architectures, containerisation, Kubernetes, observability platforms, CI/CD, and modern platform engineering practices.
Experience with AI governance, responsible AI principles, evaluation frameworks, model quality metrics, or monitoring of AI-enabled systems.
Exposure to domain-driven design, micro frontend architectures, platform strategies, or modular product architectures that enable multiple teams to deliver independently and consistently.

Our Benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of employee benefits including: retirement investment and tools designed to help you in building a sound financial future; access to education reimbursement; comprehensive resources to support your physical health and emotional well-being; family support programs; and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)

Build technology that solves real business problems
We are looking for an experienced Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
to work at the intersection of technology, data, AI and the business.

This is not a traditional software engineering role. You will work directly with our investment, operations and distribution teams, spending time with the people who use our technology to understand their workflows, identify meaningful problems and build solutions that make a measurable difference.

You will have the autonomy to take ideas from problem definition through to production, often moving from prototype to a working solution in days or weeks rather than months.

The role
As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will:
Work directly with business teams to understand their workflows, challenges and opportunities.
Identify high-impact problems where software, automation, data or AI can improve how we operate.
Rapidly prototype solutions, test them with users and iterate based on real-world feedback.
Take successful prototypes through to production, building secure, reliable and maintainable services.
Work across the full technology stack, including backend services, APIs, data pipelines and user-facing applications.
Integrate data and systems across APIs, databases, files and message queues, turning complex and fragmented data into useful products and services.
Apply modern AI and LLM capabilities to accelerate delivery and create new ways of working.
Partner closely with engineering, data and platform teams to align with architecture, security and technology standards.
Maintain a strong focus on security, governance, data protection and operational resilience, particularly where solutions interact with client assets and regulated activity.

About you
You are a hands-on engineer and pragmatic problem solver who enjoys being close to the people you build for.
You are comfortable operating in environments where the problem is not always clearly defined. You can ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, make sensible trade-offs and move quickly from an idea to something users can actually work with.
You are equally comfortable discussing architecture with engineers, mapping a business process with a subject matter expert, or explaining a technical trade-off to a senior stakeholder.
Most importantly, you care about building the right thing, not simply building things right.

Experience needed for the role:
4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of delivering and supporting production systems.
Experience taking projects end to end, from problem definition and design through development, deployment and ongoing improvement.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer | Enterprise | Full-Stack
jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.

Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What Sets Us Apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication
. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.

You will join the Business Acceleration Track (BAT)
. This is the engine room of DeepL’s global growth. While our Research teams build the models, BAT builds the Revenue Flywheel
that allows 200,000+ Enterprises (like the Fortune 500) to actually use and pay for them at scale .

We are moving upmarket. We are transitioning from a consumer-focused app to a mission-critical Enterprise Platform. You will be part of the team architecting the "Financial Nervous System" of DeepL — handling everything from Identity & Access Management (SSO, SCIM) to complex multi-seat Subscription Architectures and Fraud Prevention .

We don't hire engineers to just implement UI tickets. We hire Missionaries
who understand that a perfect AI model is useless if a Global Enterprise can't provision it securely to 50,000 employees. You will own the full vertical: from the user-facing Admin Console in React to the distributed billing logic in C#/.NET.

Your Responsibilities

Architect Revenue-Critical Flows: You will design and ship complex, high-stakes features like "Enterprise Licensing" or "Automated Seat Provisioning." You ensure that when a customer upgrades, the UX is instant, and the billing ledger is immutable.
Own the "Enterprise Experience": You will build the tools that empower CIOs and IT Directors to manage DeepL. You translate complex backend constraints (RBAC, Rate Limits) into simple, elegant UI workflows.
Bridge the Gap: You are bilingual in "Engineering" and "Business." You work directly with Sales, Product, and Finance to translate "Annual Recurring Revenue" goals into scalable technical architectures .
Drive System Reliability: You understand that billing systems cannot fail. You build for idempotency and resilience, ensuring that our financial data is auditable and flawless, while maintaining a high-velocity frontend experience.

Qualities we look for

A "Product-First" Mindset: You care deeply about the customer journey. You ask, "How does this feature help us close the next Enterprise deal?" before writing code.
Full-Stack Fluency: You are comfortable traversing the stack. You can design a React component for an Admin Dashboard in the morning and debug a distributed transaction in the backend in the afternoon.
Enterprise Domain Curiosity: You are interested in the hard problems of B2B SaaS—Identity (SAML/SSO), Monetization, and Compliance. You understand that these aren't "boring details"; they are the pillars of trust for enterprise clients .
High Agency: You don't wait for permission. If the billing reconciliation process is slow, you automate it. If the documentation for the API is unclear, you fix it.
AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like GitHub Copilot or Claude) to accelerate your velocity and eliminate repetitive toil. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving.

A Note on Our Hiring Process:
DeepL hires for the Company
, not just a specific team. We operate a Unified Engineering Pipeline
. If you pass our bar, we will match you to the highest-priority role that fits your skillset—whether that is in Core Product, Platform, Voice, or Enterprise. We prioritize "Missionaries" who want to solve the biggest problems, wherever they live in the stack .

What We Offer

Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.
Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.
Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

jobs.description:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started.

How You'll Make an Impact:

As a Staff Software Engineer
in Revenue Intelligence, you will shape the technical direction of systems that help hospitality businesses understand demand, identify revenue opportunities, and make better pricing and commercial decisions. You will work across customer-facing applications, backend services, data pipelines, analytical stores, recommendation workflows, and cloud infrastructure. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will solve complex engineering problems directly while establishing architecture, improving reliability and security, reducing systemic technical debt, and aligning multiple teams around durable technical decisions. Your impact will extend beyond individual features to the quality, scalability, operability, and long-term evolution of the Revenue Intelligence platform.

Our Revenue Intelligence Team:

The Revenue Intelligence team builds products and platforms that turn hospitality data into practical decisions for hoteliers, including pricing recommendations, demand insights, reporting, automation, and commercial opportunities. Our systems span frontend experiences, APIs, distributed services, data processing, machine-learning workflows, and production infrastructure. We value pragmatic engineering, strong ownership, evidence-based decisions, and technical leaders who raise the effectiveness of the people and systems around them.

What You Bring to the Team:

Set and evolve the technical strategy for Revenue Intelligence, translating product and business goals into coherent architecture and executable engineering plans
Lead the design and delivery of complex capabilities across customer-facing web applications, backend APIs, event-driven services, data pipelines, analytical storage, and recommendation workflows
Identify and resolve systemic risks in scalability, reliability, security, data quality, observability, and operability before they become recurring customer or engineering problems
Drive modernization of legacy systems and infrastructure through incremental, well-reasoned migrations that preserve delivery momentum and production stability
Partner with Product, Data Science, Infrastructure, Security, and engineering leaders to define boundaries, contracts, ownership, and long-term platform direction
Remain hands-on in the codebase through implementation, technical spikes, design reviews, debugging, incident response, and the most consequential or ambiguous engineering work
Raise the technical effectiveness of the wider organization through mentoring, architecture guidance, engineering standards, documentation, and constructive challenge

What Sets You Up for Success:

10+ years of software engineering experience, including significant technical leadership across complex production systems
Deep hands-on expertise in Python, with the ability to work effectively across both ecosystems and guide engineering decisions beyond a single language
Strong architecture and distributed-systems fundamentals, including API design, event-driven workflows, consistency, failure handling, scalability, and service boundaries
Experience with data-intensive systems such as PostgreSQL, Redshift, or similar analytical platforms, batch and streaming pipelines, and large-scale data processing
Experience designing or operating recommendation systems, machine-learning platforms, pricing systems, experimentation workflows, or other decision-support products
Strong cloud and platform engineering experience across AWS, containers, Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm, Argo CD, CI/CD, observability, and secure production operations
A demonstrated ability to lead through influence, create alignment across teams, communicate complex tradeoffs clearly, and drive decisions from ambiguity to execution
A strong record of improving engineering quality through testing strategy, operational readiness, incident learning, security, documentation, and sustainable technical standards
Product judgment and customer empathy, with the ability to connect technical investments to measurable outcomes for hoteliers and the business
Business-level English fluency and experience collaborating effectively in a remote, globally distributed organization

Deep hands-on expertise in .NET/C#

What to Expect - Your Journey with Us

Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team of redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ employees across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle.

Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary.

Company Description

Hitachi Solutions Europe is a global Digital, Data and Technology consultancy, Microsoft Gold partner and Cloud Services partner, specialising in end-to-end transformation.

As a global consultancy firm working across the private and public sectors, we specialise in Dynamics 365 Business Applications, Power Platform, including Azure, Application Modernisation and Data & Analytics.

Our highly skilled team help drive improvements, creating efficiency and growth within organisations. We are committed to Microsoft technologies, with a mission to revolutionise modern businesses. To achieve this we employ the best, most dedicated talent to deliver outstanding technology solutions to both our local and global clients.

Be part of our Hitachi family

We place value on collaboration, open communication, and transparency. We emphasise the importance of team spirit, cohesion, and appreciation – And through our talented people, innovative culture, and technical and business expertise, we deliver game changing outcomes every day. Our learning culture and flat hierarchy are our recipes for success. But don´t take our word for it – Have a look at what our employees are saying: Hitachi Solutions: Recruiting the best talent and offering outstanding career opportunities (hitachi-solutions.co.uk)

What To Expect, Your Benefits

Hitachi Solutions offers competitive compensation packages (incl. bonuses), pension and benefits plans. Work/Life balance is an essential part of our culture, and all our employees are home workers, although you will be expected to come into our or customer’s offices regularly. We operate a comprehensive career development programme that includes mentoring and training plans to ensure that you will continue to grow and develop your career at Hitachi.

Job Description

We are growing our consulting team, and looking for an experienced AI Architect
to lead the design and delivery of secure, scalable and responsible AI solutions across enterprise and public‑sector programmes. This role combines hands‑on technical expertise with strong architectural leadership, shaping end‑to‑end AI solutions from early discovery through to production delivery and scale.

You will act as a trusted advisor to clients and internal teams, defining AI architectures, setting standards and guardrails, and ensuring AI is applied where it delivers real business value.

Key Responsibilities

Design and own end‑to‑end AI client-specific solution architectures, including Generative AI, Agents and traditional ML.
Define and maintain enterprise AI architecture patterns, reference architectures, and reusable building blocks within the Microsoft ecosystem.
Lead AI governance, security and Responsible AI by design, ensuring solutions meet regulatory, ethical and organisational standards.
Provide architectural oversight across delivery teams, ensuring quality and scalability.
Support pre‑sales and discovery, shaping solution approaches and technical estimates and delivery roadmaps.
Advise stakeholders on AI feasibility, trade‑offs, risks and long‑term sustainability.
Build hands-on prototypes, reference implementations and reusable accelerators to remain close enough to the code to set credible technical direction and unblock delivery teams.

Qualifications

Required Skills & Experience

Significant overall experience delivering AI and Data solutions in complex enterprise environments, with a minimum of 5 years hands-on AI delivery experience.
Proven experience delivering production-grade AI solutions end‑to‑end, from discovery through to live operations and ongoing model management.
Hands-on expertise across Microsoft cloud and AI ecosystem, including Microsoft Foundry and data platform.
Strong experience with integrating low-code Power Platform solutions into enterprise-scale solutions, including hands-on experience with Copilot Studio.
Solid understanding of Microsoft security, identity and compliance (Entra ID, RBAC, network isolation, data protection).
Strong experience designing LLM‑based solutions, including Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering strategies and agent‑based architectures, leveraging frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, LangChain, and Microsoft Agent Framework.
Deep practical experience with classical Machine Learning, including supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering, model selection, training pipelines, evaluation frameworks and production lifecycle management, equivalent in depth to GenAI expertise.
Proven ability to assess client use cases and make well-reasoned architectural decisions between classical ML and Generative AI approaches; and articulate clearly why.
Strong experience in cloud‑native architecture, including API‑based and event‑driven designs, enterprise integration patterns and architectures focused on scalability, resilience and reliability.
Experience with DevOps, MLOps and LLMOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, environment strategies and operating LLM‑based solutions in production, with a strong focus on model and prompt lifecycle management, observability and evaluation, reliability and cost management.
Strong understanding of Generative AI governance, operational controls and cost evaluation, including monitoring usage, performance and designing solutions that are supportable, auditable and sustainable at scale.
Strong experience embedding Responsible AI and governance into Generative AI solutions, covering safety, risk management, transparency, explainability, human‑in‑the‑loop design and regulatory alignment.
Desirable experience in integrating enterprise data platforms with AI solutions, including familiarity with Lakehouse architectures and data engineering principles.
Proven experience in a consulting role, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes, effectively engaging non‑technical stakeholders and senior leaders.
Good experience of managing and mentoring junior AI engineers or consultants.
Must hold at least two relevant Microsoft certifications (AI-901, AI-103, DP-800 AZ‑305., AI-300),or be actively working towards them.

Candidates must hold, or be eligible for, UK Security Clearance.

Additional Information

In applying for a role with Hitachi Solutions Europe Limited and/or its affiliates (“Hitachi”) you consent to Hitachi collecting and storing your personal information (including your name, job title and email address) in relation to this role and any others that may be suitable in the future. For more information please refer to our Privacy

Policy located at Privacy policy (hitachi-solutions.co.uk)

Beware of scams

Our recruiting team may communicate with candidates via our @hitachisolutions.com domain email address and/or via our SmartRecruiters (Applicant Tracking System) [email protected] domain email address regarding your application and interview requests.

All offers will originate from our @hitachisolutions.com domain email address. If you receive an offer or information from someone purporting to be an employee of Hitachi Solutions from any other domain, it may not be legitimate.

Description

At Xe, we live currencies. We provide a comprehensive range of currency services and products, including our Currency Converter, Market Analysis, Currency Data API and quick, easy, secure Money Transfers for individuals and businesses. We leverage technology to deliver these services through our website, mobile app and by phone. Last year, we helped over 300 million people access information about the currencies that matter to them and over 225,000 people used us to send money overseas.

About This Role

We're hiring a senior back-end engineer who owns real problems end-to-end and shapes how the team builds, from API design and data modeling through to service implementation, production reliability, and launch. You already use AI as part of how you think, build, test, and ship.

You'll write code that moves money in production, design and modernize the backend services the platform runs on, and lead delivery of new capability as Xe rebuilds its platform layer. jobs.title: Senior Engineer - Open Banking Europe
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Senior Engineer - Open Banking Europe

Overview

Software engineers working on Mastercard’s Open Banking platform play a key role in the development and maintenance of the products that secure high quality connectivity to banks across Europe. Building on the strong foundation of our state-of-the-art bank connectivity APIs, the engineers create turn-key solutions that take the burden of handling account information and payment initiation services from customers that want to spend their efforts building great products that leverage the full potential of the Open Banking standard.

Role

Open Banking engineers work at the bleeding edge of the account information and payment initiation technologies, often solving problems that are yet to be tackled within the industry in areas of API security, data accessibility, processing, and analysis. You will be joining a group of highly skilled individuals working together as a team to push the limits of what is possible to achieve with open banking.

You will have many colleagues around different countries, with your nearest peers being located primarily in Denmark, Ireland and Poland.

About You

We are looking for motivated individuals that are looking to be a part of an established team comprised of both industry veterans as well as newcomers. What they all have in common is the understanding that in order to achieve great things, being able to work together as a team is a must.

You will be spending most of your time in the Microsoft domain, meaning APIs built in C# with .NET (latest version) and ASP.NET deployed to the cloud (Azure, AWS). Deep knowledge of at least some of these areas is a requirement. However, we believe that learning is a part of the job, so if you for example have extensive experience building ASP.NET apps, but not in the cloud, do not hesitate to apply regardless.

Beyond that, it is expected that you have experience building software using modern development standards, meaning it should not come as a surprise that we utilise all the tools at our disposal from standard ticketing systems (Azure DevOps), VCS, test automation, to CI/CD pipelines.

Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.description:

At Endava, we harness technology to drive meaningful change. By combining AI-native engineering, deep industry expertise and a people-centric mindset, we partner with leading organisations to solve complex business challenges and create digital products and platforms that make a lasting impact.

From strategy and design to engineering and operations, we help our customers accelerate innovation and transform their businesses. Join us and be part of a global team delivering work that matters.

Job Description

As part of Endava's strategic partnership with WTW, who provide data-driven, insight-led solutions in the areas of people, risk and capital, we're building dedicated software engineering teams to support WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology Division.

WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology business is a global leader in P&C, Life and Health insurance software and advisory services, with over 1,700 colleagues across 35 markets. More than 1,000 insurers worldwide trust our combination of advisory insight and advanced software to help them navigate complexity and drive sustainable growth.

Joining Endava, you'll work exclusively with WTW to help embed AI-enabled engineering practices, modern ways of working and deep insurance technology expertise, contributing to the next generation of products and services for insurers worldwide. Working as part of a dedicated team established through a Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) model, you'll collaborate closely with WTW while building your career as an Endava employee, supporting the long-term success of this strategic partnership.

About the Role

As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer, you will join an experienced cross-functional engineering team responsible for designing, developing and evolving the Authentication and Authorization capability used across multiple products and engineering teams.

This is not a traditional application development role. Instead, you will help build a reusable identity platform that enables other engineering teams to adopt standardised authentication and authorisation services while improving security, developer experience and operational efficiency.

The capability provides shared identity and access management services that help applications authenticate users securely, authorise access to business resources and integrate with enterprise identity providers.

Built on Auth0, Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA) and modern Azure services, it includes reusable SDKs, reverse proxy services and developer tooling that make secure integration simpler across ICT’s technology landscape.

You will work closely with architects, product teams, platform engineers and business stakeholders helping deliver secure, scalable and high-quality technology solutions that create value for WTW and its customers. You will be expected to work with a high degree of autonomy, take ownership of significant work packages and make sound technical decisions within the agreed platform direction.

What Success Looks Like

In this role you will:

Help deliver secure, reusable authentication and authorization services used by multiple product teams.
Build high-quality .NET APIs, Angular administration tools and integration services that are maintainable and easy to operate.
Improve the reliability, scalability and security of shared identity services through well-tested engineering changes.
Support platform adoption by improving SDKs, documentation, developer tooling and integration patterns.
Contribute to automation, CI/CD and cloud platform improvements that make delivery faster and more predictable.
Collaborate with architects, product owners, QA, DevOps and consuming product teams to solve identity and access management challenges.
Actively learn, share knowledge and contribute to a positive engineering culture within the Quartz team.

Key Responsibilities

Identity Platform Development

Design, develop and maintain authentication and authorization services using modern .NET technologies.
Develop reusable platform services supporting secure authentication and authorization across multiple business applications.
Build scalable REST APIs and integration services used throughout the organisation.
Develop and maintain Angular-based administration portals supporting user, group and permission management.
Contribute to the evolution of Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA) capabilities and centralized access management services.

Platform Services & Developer Experience

Develop reusable SDKs, libraries and APIs that simplify integration with the enterprise identity platform.
Build developer tooling that improves onboarding and adoption of shared authentication services.
Improve developer experience by simplifying authentication, authorization and platform integration.
Produce and maintain technical documentation supporting engineering teams consuming the platform.
Help minimise breaking changes by designing stable, reusable platform interfaces.
Take ownership of technical designs and implementation approaches for assigned capabilities, identifying dependencies, risks and trade-offs and following work through to a production-ready outcome.
Lead focused technical work packages and provide practical guidance to other engineers contributing to the same capability.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

Develop cloud-native services running on Microsoft Azure.
Build and maintain reverse proxy capabilities using Azure API Management.
Support Infrastructure as Code implementation using OpenTofu/Terraform.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation using Azure DevOps.
Support continuous improvements in platform scalability, security and operational resilience.

Engineering Excellence

Write unit, integration and automated tests ensuring platform quality and reliability.
Participate in peer reviews, architecture discussions and technical design sessions.
Promote engineering best practices including Clean Code, automated testing and secure software development.
Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, QA Engineers and Platform Engineers to deliver high-quality platform capabilities.
Support less experienced engineers through constructive reviews, knowledge sharing and technical mentoring.

Operations & Collaboration

Participate in third-line production support and on-call rotation.
Investigate production issues and contribute to platform reliability improvements.
Work closely with multiple product teams integrating with the platform.
Share knowledge and contribute to establishing long-term Endava ownership of the Authentication & Authorization capability.

Qualifications

Software Engineering

6+ years of commercial software development experience using C# and modern .NET.
Strong experience designing and developing REST APIs.
Experience building scalable enterprise applications or shared platform services.
Strong knowledge of object-oriented programming and modern software design principles.

Identity & Security

Strong understanding of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC) and JWT.
Good understanding of modern authentication and authorization concepts.
Experience integrating applications with enterprise identity providers.
Understanding of secure API design and identity-based access control.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

Experience developing cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure.
Experience with Azure DevOps, Git and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience using Infrastructure as Code with Terraform or OpenTofu.
Understanding of Azure API Management or similar API Gateway technologies.

Front-End Development

Experience developing Angular applications using TypeScript.
Experience building administrative or developer-facing web applications.

Engineering Practices

Experience writing automated tests (unit, integration and API testing).
Experience working in Agile Scrum teams.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Ability to work effectively across multiple product teams.
Ability to influence technical outcomes across team boundaries, communicate delivery risks and contribute to decisions affecting shared platform consumers.

Preferred Skills and Experience

Auth0
Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA)
Google Zanzibar authorization model
Azure API Management (APIM)
SCIM integrations
Identity Federation Datadog
Playwright
Trivy
GitLeaks
Invicti
Experience building reusable developer platforms
Experience working with enterprise shared services

Our benefits offering typically include private medical insurance, dental plan, and glasses reimbursement. The figure represents the initial remuneration we expect to offer for this role and does not limit the right to equal pay for women and men performing the same work or work of equal value. : Rzeszów (remote/hybrid options available)
Salary
: 13-20K PLN gross per month – Umowa o Pracę
Job Type
: Full-Time, Permanent

Are you looking to make your mark in a developer-centric and technology-focused software company? NewOrbit are looking for skilful software engineers wanting to expand their experience and be a central part of our exciting and growing team.

About Us NewOrbit Poland is a sister company of NewOrbit, a successful, innovative UK-based business that has been delivering software for nearly 15 years. We are a skilled and close-knit team, who work together to deliver entirely bespoke, highly-scalable, cloud-hosted web applications for our clients. We collaborate with a wide variety of clients, which means you gain exposure to lots of different industries - and challenges to solve.
Our stack is typically React
, . NET
, and Azure SQL Server
or Cosmos DB
, but expect variations on that as NewOrbit host everything on Azure
using a wide range of the available technologies. We’re a Microsoft Solutions Partner
, working very closely with Microsoft, including on new Azure technologies before they are released to the general public.

Candidate Requirements Our ideal candidate is someone with breadth, including C#
, TypeScript
, HTML/CSS
, and SQL
. You don’t need to be an expert in all of them, but you do need some full-stack experience. Ideally, you’ll have had some exposure to distributed system design and the full life-cycle of software development.
You will be comfortable estimating and designing features, and communicating with others. For a more senior role, you’ll need experience in technical leadership. There’s no staff management required for this role, but if that’s your one of your career goals then we have opportunities for that too.
NewOrbit use Agile
software development methods, so you should understand these approaches. If you’ve done Scrum that’s ideal, but an Agile mindset is more important.
Although not essential for the role, some test automation experience (e.g. test architecture, CI/CD) would be advantageous.

Overview of Responsibilities Working as part of a small project team where everyone is involved in the planning and execution of work.
Producing clean code to agreed timescales and quality.
Owning features and delivering them with minimal supervision.
Reviewing and submitting pull requests.
Handing over features for acceptance testing.
Owning or contributing to technical design and architecture.

For more senior candidates you would also be:
Leading a small project team of developers, you would be working alongside a project manager and product owner, but still very ‘hands-on’ and in code day-to-day.
Mentoring other members of the development team.
Assessing new technologies and patterns.
Helping us to interview potential candidates for the team.

Why NewOrbit? Being part of NewOrbit is much more than just a salary and holiday allowance (although those are important too!). Your package will include the following benefits, so you can share in our success:
Hybrid and remote working options – expect to visit our offices occasionally, ideally weekly. But let us know if you need more — or less!
Profit share scheme (discretionary)
Private LuxMed healthcare
MultiSport card co-financing
A friendly environment full of fellow enthusiasts:
Meals out
Activity days & retreat weekends
Outdoor activities

Work with us to: Enjoy what you do
: We hire smart people who share our drive and are genuinely proud of our team. We do projects that we believe in and aren’t afraid to challenge clients (and say no). We get our work done and go home - there’s no late-night working culture here.
Grow your career
: Our supportive environment and clear career paths help you thrive. NewOrbit provide access to Pluralsight and Frontend Masters on-demand training and share knowledge within the team through tech talks & coding sessions. We can also provide you with time or learning resources to get Azure certified.
Stay interested
: We welcome innovation and stay at the forefront, actively encouraging side projects and experimentation. We provide you with monthly Azure credits that you can use for whatever you like.
Have an impact
: Our driver is to make a positive difference to our clients and the team, so we look for people who own problems and feel personal pride in what they do. We rely on everyone in the team to look outwards and help decide and drive our technical strategy. If you think there’s something we can do better, we’ll listen.

Application Process Interested?
Please send your CV and any useful links you might have (Stack Overflow, GitHub, open source projects) to recruitment@neworbit.pl.
The next step would be a short 10-15 minute telephone call to have a quick chat about what you are interested in and your past experience.
You will then be invited to complete a programming exercise at your own pace via TestDome – typically around an hour of coding, done whenever suits you best.
If the exercise goes well, we’ll invite you for a final conversation with one of our team – around an hour to dig into your experience, values, and of course an opportunity for you to ask us questions. You will then get feedback on our decision either way – and we might even make you an offer there and then!

We look forward to hearing from you.

Please note: This role is Poland based and candidates are required to have the legal right to work in the Poland for employment.
A background check (including criminal records check and references) is required for this role.
NewOrbit are committed to a safe work environment that supports and respects equality, diversity and inclusion within our team.

jobs.description:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started.

Location:

Remote (Europe)

How You'll Make an Impact:

As a Staff Software Engineer
in Revenue Intelligence, you will shape the technical direction of systems that help hospitality businesses understand demand, identify revenue opportunities, and make better pricing and commercial decisions. You will work across customer-facing applications, backend services, data pipelines, analytical stores, recommendation workflows, and cloud infrastructure. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will solve complex engineering problems directly while establishing architecture, improving reliability and security, reducing systemic technical debt, and aligning multiple teams around durable technical decisions. Your impact will extend beyond individual features to the quality, scalability, operability, and long-term evolution of the Revenue Intelligence platform.

Our Revenue Intelligence Team:

The Revenue Intelligence team builds products and platforms that turn hospitality data into practical decisions for hoteliers, including pricing recommendations, demand insights, reporting, automation, and commercial opportunities. Our systems span frontend experiences, APIs, distributed services, data processing, machine-learning workflows, and production infrastructure. We value pragmatic engineering, strong ownership, evidence-based decisions, and technical leaders who raise the effectiveness of the people and systems around them.

What You Bring to the Team:

Set and evolve the technical strategy for Revenue Intelligence, translating product and business goals into coherent architecture and executable engineering plans
Lead the design and delivery of complex capabilities across customer-facing web applications, backend APIs, event-driven services, data pipelines, analytical storage, and recommendation workflows
Identify and resolve systemic risks in scalability, reliability, security, data quality, observability, and operability before they become recurring customer or engineering problems
Drive modernization of legacy systems and infrastructure through incremental, well-reasoned migrations that preserve delivery momentum and production stability
Partner with Product, Data Science, Infrastructure, Security, and engineering leaders to define boundaries, contracts, ownership, and long-term platform direction
Remain hands-on in the codebase through implementation, technical spikes, design reviews, debugging, incident response, and the most consequential or ambiguous engineering work
Raise the technical effectiveness of the wider organization through mentoring, architecture guidance, engineering standards, documentation, and constructive challenge

What Sets You Up for Success:

10+ years of software engineering experience, including significant technical leadership across complex production systems
Deep hands-on expertise in Python, with the ability to work effectively across both ecosystems and guide engineering decisions beyond a single language
Strong architecture and distributed-systems fundamentals, including API design, event-driven workflows, consistency, failure handling, scalability, and service boundaries
Experience with data-intensive systems such as PostgreSQL, Redshift, or similar analytical platforms, batch and streaming pipelines, and large-scale data processing
Experience designing or operating recommendation systems, machine-learning platforms, pricing systems, experimentation workflows, or other decision-support products
Strong cloud and platform engineering experience across AWS, containers, Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm, Argo CD, CI/CD, observability, and secure production operations
A demonstrated ability to lead through influence, create alignment across teams, communicate complex tradeoffs clearly, and drive decisions from ambiguity to execution
A strong record of improving engineering quality through testing strategy, operational readiness, incident learning, security, documentation, and sustainable technical standards
Product judgment and customer empathy, with the ability to connect technical investments to measurable outcomes for hoteliers and the business
Business-level English fluency and experience collaborating effectively in a remote, globally distributed organization

Bonus Skills to Stand Out:

Deep hands-on expertise in .NET/C#

What to Expect - Your Journey with Us

Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team of redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ employees across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle.

Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary.

Design, build, and maintain system integrations and new platform capabilities supporting Operations and CX teams
Leverage AI capabilities (including LLM-based applications and multi-agent systems) to enhance system intelligence and automate decision-making
Identify manual, repetitive processes and transform them into scalable, AI-driven workflows
Partner closely with Operations, Product, and Engineering stakeholders to translate business needs into technical solutions
Ensure internal tools are reliable, observable, secure, and continuously evolving through proactive improvements and monitoring

Requirements

API Integration: Experience working with REST APIs to connect disparate systems and build cohesive technical ecosystems. - Must

Desirable

Coding: Advantage Experience with Python coding is a significant plus.
Familiarity with additional languages.

What’s in it for you?

Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment

Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies

Care: We've got you covered with company-paid premium medical package through Luxmed
Benefits: Access the MyBenefit cafeteria platform, allowing you to choose perks that best suit your lifestyle and needs

jobs.title: Senior Java Backend Developer
jobs.description:
Project Description:

The project is part of the Credit, Asset-backed & Securitized Products (CASP) division of an investment bank, focusing on platforms that support securitization and structured finance products. The current primary objective is migrating existing on-premise systems to a modern Microsoft Azure cloud environment, transforming legacy architecture into scalable, cloud-native solutions. It involves rebuilding and adapting systems used for structuring, processing, and distributing securities such as ABS, MBS, and CLOs. The platform integrates with trading, risk, and regulatory systems to support both real-time and batch data processing. The target architecture follows a microservices-based approach with containerized services deployed on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Infrastructure provisioning and configuration are managed using Terraform as Infrastructure as Code. The system leverages REST APIs and event-driven communication to ensure scalability and flexibility during and after migration. Special focus is placed on maintaining data consistency, performance, and regulatory compliance throughout the transition. The project emphasizes high availability, resilience, and observability in a complex financial ecosystem. AI-assisted development tools like GitHub Copilot are integrated to enhance engineering productivity. The environment promotes modern engineering practices, automation, and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Java 11+ and Spring Boot within a microservices architecture.
Build and enhance RESTful APIs and message-driven services supporting securitization and credit workflows.
Develop and deploy cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure, including AKS-based container orchestration.
Use Terraform to define and manage infrastructure as code.
Work with containerization technologies (Docker) and contribute to CI/CD pipelines using GitLab or GitHub.
Implement integrations using messaging systems such as Kafka, IBM MQ, or Tibco EMS.
Collaborate on system design, ensuring scalability, resilience, and alignment with distributed architecture principles.
Develop and optimize database interactions using Azure SQL, Oracle, or Sybase.
Write and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure code quality and reliability.
Implement monitoring, logging, and observability practices to support production systems.
Utilize Linux/Unix skills for troubleshooting and scripting.
Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve efficiency while maintaining high coding standards.

Mandatory Skills Description:

Strong object-oriented programming skills with Java 11+
Extensive experience with Spring Boot / Spring ecosystem
Hands-on development of Web and/or REST APIs and message-driven services
Experience building and running containerized applications
Strong experience with Azure cloud, including:
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform
Kubernetes (AKS) and container orchestration
Compute (VMs) and storage solutions (e.g., Azure Files)
Solid Linux/Unix skills (shell scripting, system understanding)
Experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) integrated into development workflows
Experience with GitLab / GitHub, IntelliJ / VSCode

🏠 Hybrid work (3 days/week from the office)

🌐 Fully remote recruitment process

Welcome to Digital, IT & Operations (DI&O) Architecture

You’ll be part of the Network Product Line architecture team where you, together with your colleagues, will define architecture standards, guide global infrastructure delivery, and ensure scalable, secure, and consistent networking solutions across business units and platforms.

As a team, we collaborate closely across domains, share knowledge, and continuously develop to deliver secure, scalable, and high-quality infrastructure solutions.

You'll play an important role in:

designing and documenting enterprise network architecture for cloud and on-prem environments, aligned with business requirements and reference architectures based on Cisco, Palo Alto and Citrix technology stack
identifying architecture patterns, develop guidelines, reference and solution architectures and anchor these in the Ørsted’s Network Product Line
supporting change management by guiding technology implementation, testing, and service transition across its lifecycle
identifying and driving optimization opportunities across infrastructure, including automation and process improvements
shaping and recommending technologies, translating business needs into architecture designs, features, and user stories
collaborating with solution managers, architects, engineers, and vendors to align technologies with strategy and ensure consistent implementation.

To succeed in the role, you:

hold relevant technology certifications - Cisco CCNP/CCIE, Palo Alto Network Security Architect/Network Security Professional, architecture certifications - TOGAF, ArchiMate or equivalent experience, combined with hands-on expertise in key technologies such as Cisco ACI, SD-Access, SD-WAN, Citrix NetScaler, and Palo Alto firewalls
have exposure to cloud networking in Azure or AWS platforms and to regulated or compliance-driven environments
worked with IT frameworks such as ITIL®, SAFe and regulatory frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIS2 or NERC CIP
possess general knowledge and skills in programming, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code with Terraform and Configuration Management with Ansible
have deep and profound experience with infrastructure architecture, solution design and documentation

Shape the future with us

Thinkproject is a leading provider of construction intelligence software, helping engineering and construction companies manage their most complex projects. Our

platforms are used by major infrastructure, energy, and real estate organisations across Europe and beyond to digitise, connect, and control construction workflows.

Develop and maintain the engineering and cloud infrastructure and automation infrastructure such as CI/CD pipelines, IaC code, etc. Accompaniment and optimisation of software products from development to implementation and maintenance.
