Automation: Design and implement secure automated deployment processes; implement and maintain Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines using tools like Azure DevOps, Jenkins etc. to enhance software delivery speed and reliability. Participate in designing, building, and managing scalable cloud development using Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools like Ansible, Terraform, etc. to provision and manage infrastructure resources.
Problem Solving: Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to infrastructure, applications, and deployments.
Documentation: Maintain comprehensive documentation of processes, configurations, and performance metrics to support knowledge sharing and compliance.

Experience

6+ years of DevOps/SRE experience with 3+ years focused on Azure and Azure DevOps at scale.
Proven track record owning the CI/CD + IaC platform for multiple development teams, enabling consistent, secure, and fast delivery.
Experience designing and operating production-grade releases (blue/green, canary, rollback), incident response, and post-mortems.
Experience with security and compliance frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2), change management, and audit readiness.

Experience with GCP will be an added advantage.

Ownership mindset; platform/product thinking with clear SLAs and standards.
Excellent problem-solving and structured debugging across app, infra, and pipeline layers.

Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. A Master’s degree is preferred.

Employee satisfaction is our top priority. Our people make Thinkproject what it is today. jobs.description:
Papaya Global is a rapidly growing, award-winning B2B tech unicorn with an ambitious mission to revolutionize the payroll & payments industry. With over $400M raised from multiple tier-one investors, our innovative technology provides a comprehensive solution for managing global workforces, encompassing everything from hiring and onboarding to managing and paying employees in over 160 countries.

About The Role

We're looking for a Software Architect
to join Papaya's central Architects Team
— a small group of senior architects that partners with every R&D department in the company. In this role you won't own a single product silo; instead, you'll move across domains (payments, payroll, workforce management, platform, data, security) to help teams shape sound, scalable, secure systems and to keep Papaya's overall technical direction coherent.

This is a hands-on architecture role at the intersection of engineering, product, security, and DevOps. You'll be expected to dive deep into unfamiliar domains quickly, influence without direct authority, and bring the highest bar of technical thinking — including modern AI-assisted engineering practices — to everything you touch.

If you're energized by hard problems at global scale, by working across many teams rather than one, and by shaping how a modern engineering organization actually builds software in the age of AI, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

Lead architectural design across multiple Papaya domains and infrastructure systems, ensuring solutions meet business, scalability, performance, and compliance needs.
Act as a trusted architectural partner to R&D, Product, Security, and DevOps teams — translating business and product requirements into clear technical direction.
Define and maintain high-level architecture across domains, with a focus on seamless integration, maintainability, and long-term evolvability.
Build hands-on Proofs of Concept (POCs) to de-risk architectural decisions, validate new technologies, and demonstrate viable paths forward before broad investment.
Lead technical Due Diligence on third-party vendors, platforms, and integrations — evaluating architecture fit, scalability, security posture, compliance, operational maturity, and long-term cost.
Drive secure-by-design practices, embedding security, privacy, and regulatory considerations into every stage of system design.
Evaluate and introduce emerging technologies, frameworks, and patterns — including AI/LLM-based capabilities — where they create real leverage for the business.
Champion the adoption of AI-powered engineering tools and agentic workflows across R&D, helping teams use them effectively, safely, and consistently.
Define and steward Papaya's architectural guidelines, standards, and best practices, and help ensure they are actually applied in day-to-day delivery.
Provide technical mentorship and architectural guidance to development teams across the company.
Review designs, RFCs, and critical implementations to maintain architectural consistency and system quality across projects.

Requirements:

Experience & Background

8+ years of proven experience as a System / Software Architect designing robust, scalable systems.
12+ years of hands-on software development experience, with strong proficiency in Java (preferred) or an equivalent backend language.
Proven experience building enterprise SaaS platforms, self-service products, and highly scaled production systems.
Experience in financial technology (FinTech) or other regulated industries is a strong advantage.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

Technical depth

Deep expertise in cloud-native architecture; strong advantage for AWS (Lambda, ECS, S3, RDS, IAM, etc.).
Hands-on experience with microservices, event-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS), and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
Strong command of software design patterns, SDLC, and system integration strategies.
Expertise in design paradigms such as DDD, TDD, EDD, and principles like SOLID, KISS, DRY, SSOT, and CQS.
Solid grasp of security fundamentals: encryption, authentication, authorization, data privacy, and secure coding practices.
Proficiency with SQL and NoSQL databases, and API design using REST and GraphQL.
Practical experience with Git branching strategies, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile development practices.

AI-powered Engineering (required)

Deep, hands-on experience with at least one agentic AI coding tool such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot (Agent Mode), or Codex CLI — used regularly on real, non-trivial work.
Practical fluency with AI productivity tools across the broader workflow: LLM chat assistants for design and review, AI-assisted code review, documentation generation, and research.
Ability to design effective context for AI agents — writing good prompts, structuring repos and docs (e.g. CLAUDE.md / rules files) so agents perform well, and knowing when to delegate vs. when to drive manually.
Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and the broader pattern of connecting AI agents to internal tools, data sources, and services.
Awareness of the security, privacy, IP, and quality risks of AI-assisted development, and opinions on how to mitigate them at an organizational level.
Experience integrating AI/LLM capabilities and agent-based components into backend products and workflows is a strong plus.

Ways of working

Demonstrated ability to drive end-to-end delivery of complex features — from architecture through production.
Excellent analytical skills and a strong self-learning instinct; comfortable ramping up quickly on unfamiliar domains.
Strong communication and influencing skills — able to align engineers, product managers, and senior stakeholders around a technical direction.
Excellent written and verbal English.

jobs.title: Junior website operations / web developer with Drupal
jobs.description:
In Poland
- Warsaw

We are looking for a dedicated Junior Website Content Administrator to join our global Web Team and support the development and maintenance of our Drupal-based corporate website. The role combines front-end development, content upload and implementation, CMS maintenance and improvements, and day-to-day website operations. You will work closely with the Website team, Global and Regional Campaigns teams, the broader marketing team, and key business stakeholders to translate content requirements into effective web solutions.

The salary for this position ranges from PLN 8 000 to PLN 9 000, depending on the candidate’s relevant experience, skill set, level of expertise and overall fit for the role. Additional factors such as industry background, technical competencies and interview performance may also influence the final offer. The compensation package at Simon-Kucher CBS consists of a gross base salary, a monthly remote work allowance and an annual bonus. The bonus is paid in December and is based on the results of a 360-degree performance evaluation.

Please remember to submit your application in English. Other applications will not be considered. The candidate should have an EU work permit, we do not offer visa for this position.

What Makes Us Special

Become part of a unique entrepreneurial team. Think independently, use your initiative, and take some risks. Entrepreneurship is a powerful force that drives the growth not only of our firm but our clients and people.
Unlock the power of opportunity. Advance your career in a thriving company that creates positive impact. We invest in your professional development every step of the way.
Enjoy balance and flexible working. Be empowered to do your best work – we offer flexible and hybrid working, sabbaticals, and paid time off.
Prioritize your health and wellbeing. No matter where you live, we offer a competitive suite of health benefits to help keep you and your loved ones safe.
Work in a values-driven culture. At Simon-Kucher, our vision is to become the world's leading growth specialist. Our values guide the way we do business and communicate our distinctiveness. They sum up what we stand for, influence our culture, and drive how and why we do things.

How You Will Create An Impact

Support the development and maintenance of our Drupal-based corporate website as part of the global Web Team.
Assist with implementing front-end website components based on Figma designs.
Use HTML and CSS to create and adjust website content, including tables, layouts, and other basic front-end elements.
Set up new webpages and upload, format, and publish written content, charts, tables, and graphics within the CMS.
Edit and update existing webpages in line with business updates or content revisions.
Provide first-level technical support to marketing colleagues regarding website and CMS-related questions.
Help troubleshoot basic website issues and coordinate more complex topics with developers when needed.
Perform regular quality checks (QCs) across the site to identify and fix outdated content, broken links, formatting issues, or design inconsistencies.
Ensure consistency in formatting, branding, and tone across all webpages and follow defined accessibility standards.
Coordinate with content owners, designers, and developers to resolve web issues and support publishing schedules.
Ensure our corporate website remains accurate, current, and aligned with our business needs.
Work closely with the broader marketing team to understand content requirements and translate them into simple, web-friendly formats.
Support the web development team by organizing content submissions, tracking updates, and managing content publishing timelines and day-to-day CMS maintenance.

Your Profile

Minimum 1 year of experience in website content administration, web development, or website operations.
Basic hands-on experience with Drupal is required.
Good basic knowledge of HTML and CSS and an understanding of front-end website structure and accessibility.
Ability to work with Figma designs and translate simple design requirements into website components is an advantage.
Basic understanding of website usability and accessibility principles.
Exceptional organizational and time management skills with a strong attention to detail.
Good problem-solving skills and willingness to support colleagues with basic website and CMS-related issues.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in an international environment.
You are fluent in English on a business level (C1).

If you’re interested, and if you’d like to offer your skills and commitment to our international team, then we would be pleased to receive your application.

Hit the ‘Apply Now’ button to begin your application

About Simon-Kucher

Simon-Kucher is a global consultancy with more than 2,000 employees in 30 countries. Our sole focus is on unlocking better growth that drives measurable revenue and profit for our clients. We achieve this by optimizing every lever of their commercial strategy – product, price, innovation, marketing, and sales – based on deep insights into what customers want and value. With 40 years of experience in monetization topics of all kinds, we are regarded as the world’s leading pricing and growth specialist. simon-kucher.com We believe in building a culture that embraces diversity, equity, and inclusion, creating an environment in which our people feel valued, are able to be themselves and feel their contribution matters. If we get that right, remarkable things will happen; people will grow faster, innovate, feel valued, and create better outcomes for everyone – our people, our clients and, of course, our business.

The project is part of the Credit, Asset-backed & Securitized Products (CASP) division of an investment bank, focusing on platforms that support securitization and structured finance products. The current primary objective is migrating existing on-premise systems to a modern Microsoft Azure cloud environment, transforming legacy architecture into scalable, cloud-native solutions. It involves rebuilding and adapting systems used for structuring, processing, and distributing securities such as ABS, MBS, and CLOs. The platform integrates with trading, risk, and regulatory systems to support both real-time and batch data processing. The target architecture follows a microservices-based approach with containerized services deployed on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Infrastructure provisioning and configuration are managed using Terraform as Infrastructure as Code. The system leverages REST APIs and event-driven communication to ensure scalability and flexibility during and after migration. Special focus is placed on maintaining data consistency, performance, and regulatory compliance throughout the transition. The project emphasizes high availability, resilience, and observability in a complex financial ecosystem. AI-assisted development tools like GitHub Copilot are integrated to enhance engineering productivity. The environment promotes modern engineering practices, automation, and continuous improvement.

Use Terraform to define and manage infrastructure as code.

jobs.description:
Att jobba som .NET-utvecklare

Vill du använda din erfarenhet inom .NET för att utveckla lösningar som spelar en viktig roll i arbetet mot penningtvätt?

Hos oss blir du en del av Team Norrsken i Piteå, ett erfaret och välfungerande team med stort ansvar för verksamhetskritiska lösningar. Här får du möjlighet att påverka tekniska vägval, utvecklas tillsammans med kunniga kollegor och arbeta inom ett område som får allt större betydelse.

Några Anledningar Till Att Välja Rollen

Ett uppdrag med tydligt syfte – du arbetar med lösningar inom bland annat antipenningtvätt och bidrar till utvecklingen av system som möter regulatoriska krav.
Erfarna kollegor nära dig – du blir en del av ett kompetent team med seniora systemutvecklare, teamcoach, systemansvarig, mjukvaruarkitekt och produktägare.
Påverka både lösning och arbetssätt – du får vara delaktig från krav och design till utveckling, test och förvaltning.
Möjlighet att fortsätta utvecklas – på sikt finns möjligheter att bredda dig mot exempelvis arkitektur, Teamcoach, systemansvar eller systemspecialist.
Gemenskap på kontoret i Piteå – teamet värdesätter samarbete, kunskapsutbyte och gemensamt ansvar, samtidigt som det finns möjlighet till ett flexibelt hybridarbete.

Vi är 9 personer i teamet som består av systemutvecklare, Scrum Master/Teamcoach, systemansvarig, mjukvaruarkitekt samt systemspecialist. I teamet verkar även från verksamheten en produktägare (PO).

Vi arbetar agilt med dagliga avstämning. Uppgifter och prioriteringar hanteras i Azure DevOps. Din huvudsakliga arbetsplats är vårt kontor centralt i Piteå. Vi ser ett värde i att arbeta tillsammans på plats, samtidigt som rollen erbjuder möjlighet till hybridarbete.

Tillsammans förvaltar och vidareutvecklar vi system inom bland annat antipenningtvätt, där produkten Actimize är en viktig del. I takt med utökade regulatoriska krav väntar fortsatt design och utveckling av tjänster inom området.

Dina Huvudsakliga Arbetsuppgifter Är Att

utveckla och förvalta IT-lösningar i C#, .NET och .NET Framework
delta i kravarbete och omsätta verksamhetens behov till tekniska lösningar
bidra i designarbete med hänsyn till arkitektur, livscykel och roadmap
arbeta med SQL Server, Stored Procedures, Git och enhetstester
genomföra testaktiviteter och bidra till ökad testautomation
felsöka och lösa incidenter och problem samt analysera bakomliggande orsaker
dokumentera lösningar och bidra till förbättringar av teknik, processer och teamets arbetssätt.

För att lyckas i rollen

Vi söker dig som har flera års erfarenhet från en liknande roll och gedigen erfarenhet av backendutveckling i C#och .NET. Du har även erfarenhet av MS SQL, SQL Server, Stored Procedures, Git, enhetstester och agila arbetssätt. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift.

Som person är du självgående, analytisk och lösningsorienterad med förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i teknik och verksamhet, förstå krav och omsätta dem till väl genomtänkta lösningar. Eftersom vi arbetar nära varandra behöver du också vara kommunikativ, dela med dig av kunskap och våga be om hjälp. Du bidrar med ett prestigelöst och positivt förhållningssätt där teamets gemensamma resultat står i fokus.

Det är meriterande med eftergymnasial utbildning inom relevant område samt erfarenhet av testautomation, händelsedrivna system, REST/SOAP, CI/CD, Azure DevOps, Octopus Deploy och felsökning i Splunk eller AppDynamics. Även kunskaper inom TypeScript/JavaScript, React.js och AI-utveckling är meriterande.

Vad händer nu?

Vi jobbar med löpande urval så tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet. För att göra rekryteringsprocessen så rättvis och objektiv som möjligt kommer det att ingå intervjuer, tester, bakgrundskontroll samt digital referenstagning.

Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocessen, vänligen ta kontakt med madelene.skogh@skandia.se eller rekryterande chef på margit.ronn@skandia.se.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Mer om Banken

Vi har varit pionjärer inom digital bankverksamhet sedan starten 1994, som Sveriges första helt digitala bank. Med en passion för innovation och kundfokus har vi vuxit till att erbjuda ett brett utbud av produkter och tjänster inom områdena Låna, Spara och Betala – med särskilt fokus på bolån.

Vår verksamhet är fördelad mellan Stockholm och Linköping. I Stockholm finns majoriteten av vår verksamhet, medan vår kundservice har sitt hjärta i Linköping. Tillsammans är vi cirka 270 medarbetare anställda på banken som varje dag skapar smarta lösningar för våra kunder.

Vårt Erbjudande Inkluderar

Låna: Transparenta och attraktivt prissatta bolån
Spara: Sparande i fonder och aktier samt på sparkonto
Betala: Lönekonto samt smidiga kort- och betalningstjänster.

Vi tror på att människor som utvecklas, presterar och mår bra är nyckeln till framgång. Hos oss är kompetensutveckling och lärande självklara delar av vardagen – framåt tillsammans!

National Bioinformatics Infrastructure Sweden (NBIS) söker nu ytterligare 1 systemutvecklare. Vi är en nationell infrastruktur vars syfte är att tillhandahålla support för bioinformatiker och forskare inom livsvetenskaperna. Systemutvecklingsgruppen består av två scrumteam som utvecklar verktyg för storskalig datahantering och webbapplikationer för forskargrupper och EU-finansierade projekt, allt inom området bioinformatik.

Att vara en del av ett av våra team ger dig möjlighet att göra skillnad, genom att arbeta i projekt vars mål är att göra forskningsdata säker och delbar. Du kommer att vara anställd vid Uppsala universitet, på Institutionen för cell- och molekylärbiologi (ICM), och vara knuten till NBIS och Science for Life Laboratory (SciLifeLab). Mer information om NBIS finns på https://nbis.se.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som systemutvecklare kommer du att vara ansvarig för utveckling och underhåll av en delningsplattform för mänsklig genomikdata från forskningsprojekt, i samarbete med våra partners i andra europeiska länder. Målet med dessa projekt, som Genomic Data Infrastructure (GDI), är att hjälpa forskare att kunna dela sin data på ett säkert vis, och att på så sätt underlätta deras samarbeten runt mänsklig hälsa och medicin.

Projektet GDI handlar om att möjliggöra säker tillgång till genomiska och kliniska data inom EU, för att kunna förbättra klinisk diagnostik, behandlingar och prediktiv medicin. Bigpicture är ett annat europeiskt flaggskepp som syftar till att bygga en Petabyte plattform för AI inom digital patologi. Våra samarbetspartner kommer från akademin såväl som sjukvården och industrin.

Du kommer arbeta tätt tillsammans med andra utvecklare i ett av våra scrum-team och bidra till de ovan nämnda projekten. Scrum-teamet är ansvarig för produkternas hela livscykel, från planering och utveckling, till driftsättning och underhåll. Minst fem års dokumenterad erfarenhet i systemutveckling med Python och Java
Minst fem års dokumenterad erfarenhet i Kubernetes med Helm och Hashicorp Vault eller OpenBao
Minst fem års erfarenhet av databaser, t. ex. PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB
Minst fem års dokumenterad erfarenhet av virtualiseringslösningar och mjukvaru-containrar (t.ex. Docker eller Podman)
Minst fem års erfarenhet av versionshantering med Git och CI/CD (t. ex. GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Bitbucket Pipelines)
Minst fem års erfarenhet av att arbeta agilt enligt scrum och scrum-rollerna certifikat (scrummaster eller produktägare)
Minst fem års dokumenterad erfarenhet i Infrastructure as Code med Terraform och Ansible och ett eller flera molnleverantörer (t. ex. Azure, AWS, Google Cloud)
Minst fem års erfarenhet och god förståelse av nätverk (TLS, TCP/UDP, HTTPS, routing)
Att du kan uttrycka dig obehindrat på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

jobs.title: Software and Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Join EQT Tech’s Architectural function, where you’ll play a critical role in future-proofing and scaling one of our cross-functional value streams—Fintech.

This is a unique opportunity to design and drive the technology supporting our financial operations — ensuring seamless integrations, efficiency, and innovation. If you're a strategic thinker with a strong technical foundation and a passion for designing scalable systems, we’d love to hear from you.

About The Tech Team – Fintech Value Stream

The Fintech Value Stream strives to improve and automate key financial processes to deliver a best-in-class experience for a broad range of business domains. We’re a cross-functional team collaborating closely with stakeholders across EQT to ensure data and technology strategically support business outcomes. Our team includes tech leads, data professionals, product managers and architects who together shape the future of finance operations through scalable, data-driven solutions.

What You’ll Do

As a Software and Solution Architect, you will play a key role in shaping EQT’s technical landscape within the Fintech Value Stream. Your primary responsibility will be to collaborate with Tech Leads, Engineers, and external partners to design and implement solutions that drive efficiency and scalability across EQT’s investment technology.

Beyond your work in the Fintech Value Stream, you'll also collaborate closely with peers in the Architecture function to shape EQT Tech's long-term architectural direction, ensuring consistency, reusability, and strategic alignment across value streams.

Key Responsibilities

Partner with tech leads and engineers to support the Fintech Value Stream in new projects & initiatives, engaging in technical discussions with both third-party service providers and internal teams to ensure a structured approach to solution development
Assess the current architecture, team capabilities, and resource allocation to determine the best approach for future implementations
Develop new architectural solutions and enhance existing ones to ensure they are harmonized, scalable, and efficient for all of EQT
Establish technical standards, best practices, and improved ways of working across EQT’s Tech teams
Collaborate with other Value Streams (Investment & Client) and Platform Teams to define interfaces, ownership, and capabilities within the Fintech domain
Design system integrations, ensuring seamless connectivity between internal systems, new external systems, and vendors
Work closely with the Head of Architecture and the Head of Fintech, supporting key strategic initiatives

Who are you?

We’re looking for an experienced Software and Solution Architect with a strong technical foundation and a strategic mindset. You should have a passion for problem-solving, system design, and technical leadership. You likely have 8–12 years of experience across software engineering and architecture, including time spent designing systems in regulated or data-sensitive environments.

Desired Skills & Experience

Strong software engineering background, with hands-on experience designing and maintaining complex, high-availability systems that handle sensitive data
Strong understanding of system integrations, APIs, and data architectures
Proven ability to drive implementation from initial requirements to high-level solution design and progress tracking
Strong leadership and coaching skills, with the confidence to take a firm stance in technical discussions
Excellent communication skills, able to engage effectively with key stakeholders and external partners
Proactive mindset, with a desire to learn, adapt, and drive continuous improvement
Curiosity about applying AI and advanced analytics to drive business value and innovation

Nice-to-haves

Hands-on experience with modern data stacks and frameworks (e.g., dbt, Snowflake, SQL, Fivetran)
Familiarity with financial systems such as Netsuite, Kyriba, Hazeltree, MRI, or Aaro, and BI tools like PowerBI or Hex

What We Offer

A fast-paced and dynamic work environment at a leading global investment firm
The opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology and develop the future of EQT’s financial tools
A collaborative and inclusive company culture where innovation is encouraged
Regular hackathons, workshops, and learning opportunities to develop new skills
Competitive compensation and benefits package
A vibrant office environment in central Stockholm

Inclusion at
EQT

Our vision for EQT employees is to build high performing & engaged teams. Our competitive edge comes from fostering an environment where every individual feels valued, empowered, and motivated to drive business impact. Our commitment to inclusion is not just about fairness; We understand and believe that being a great place to work drives the best performance.At EQT, inclusion is a business imperative and it's embedded into our talent strategy, decision-making, and culture to ensure that every individual and team operates at their full potential. By doing so, we unlock better collaboration, stronger innovation, and superior investment outcomes.

About EQT

EQT is a purpose-driven global investment organization focused on active ownership strategies. With a Nordic heritage and a global mindset, EQT has a track record of over three decades of developing companies across multiple geographies, sectors and strategies. EQT has investment strategies covering all phases of a business’ development, from start-up to maturity. EQT has EUR ‌ 270 billion in total assets under management (EUR ‌ ‌141 billion in fee-generating assets under management), within two business segments – Private Capital and Real Assets.

With its roots in the Wallenberg family’s entrepreneurial mindset and philosophy of long-term ownership, EQT is guided by a set of strong values and a distinct corporate culture. EQT manages and advises funds and vehicles that invest across the world with the mission to future-proof companies, generate attractive returns and make a positive impact with everything EQT does. EQT has offices in more than 25 countries across Europe, Asia and the Americas and has more than 1,900 employees.

More info: www.eqtgroup.com

Follow EQT on LinkedIn, X, YouTube and Instagram

jobs.title: Cloud Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Är du en ingenjör som hellre automatiserar ett problem än löser det två gånger? Vill du vara med och bygga plattformen som levererar livsavgörande IT-system till sjukvården – snabbare, säkrare och mer repeterbart för varje release?

Vi söker nu en nyfiken och lösningsorienterad cloud automation engineer till vårt Design-team inom Cloud Operations. Här bygger vi verktygen, koden och processerna som gör att våra molnbaserade lösningar kan sättas upp och driftas på ett standardiserat sätt över hela världen. Vi letar efter dig som drivs av att förenkla, standardisera och ta bort manuella moment – och som vill se resultatet av ditt arbete varje dag i den operativa leveransen. Vi är på väg mot ett arbetssätt med mer DevOps och platform engineering – och du blir en av dem som bygger vägen dit.

På Sectra utvecklar vi IT-lösningar som förbättrar diagnostik, behandling och patientöverlevnad, framför allt inom cancervård. Som en del av vårt team bygger du grunden som våra driftteam och i förlängningen vårdpersonal världen över står på.

Rollbeskrivning

Som cloud automation engineer hos oss kommer du att:

Utveckla och förvalta automation för uppsättning av nya kundsystem – från infrastruktur och konfiguration till installation av våra medicinska IT-produkter.
Bygga automation och verktyg för operations så att återkommande driftmoment blir självbetjänade, förutsägbara och spårbara i stället för manuella.
Arbeta nära våra driftteam för att identifiera var tiden faktiskt går och omsätta det i konkreta förbättringar i kod och process.

Hos oss får du en roll som kombinerar teknisk utveckling med verklig operativ förankring. Du blir en del av ett erfaret och kompetent team där kunskapsdelning, kodgranskning och samarbete står i fokus.

Placering

Denna roll är baserad på vårt huvudkontor i Linköping. Möjlighet till internationella uppdrag finns för dig som är intresserad av att arbeta utomlands på både korta och längre uppdrag.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter

Utveckling av automation och scripting för installation, konfiguration och uppgradering av våra system.
Design av standardiserade, återanvändbara lösningar som gör leveransen likadan oavsett kund och geografi.
Förbättring av arbetsflöden i drift genom verktyg, pipelines och infrastructure as code.
Felsökning och grundorsaksanalys – och att bygga bort problemet så att det inte återkommer.

,

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som har

En BSc eller MSc inom Datateknik, Teknisk Fysik, Medieteknik eller motsvarande.
Ett genuint intresse för kodning och automation – du behöver inte vara renodlad utvecklare, men du ska trivas med att lösa problem med kod.
Förståelse för hur IT-miljöer hänger ihop: virtualisering, nätverk, operativsystem och databaser.
En analytisk och pragmatisk inställning, med förmåga att se mönstret bakom det manuella arbetet.
Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Meriterande erfarenheter

Erfarenhet av scripting och automation, exempelvis PowerShell, Python, Bash eller Ansible/Terraform.
Kunskaper inom CI/CD pipelines, versionshantering, containerteknik eller infrastructure as code.
Kompetenser inom IT-säkerhet, virtuella Windows- eller Linux-miljöer, MS SQL Server AlwaysOn, Active Directory, lagringslösningar och MS Azure.
Tidigare erfarenhet av projekt i internationella miljöer.
Intresse eller engagemang utanför arbetet, exempelvis idrott, musik eller ideellt arbete.

Vad vi erbjuder dig

Möjlighet att bygga automation som gör verklig skillnad för patienter och vårdgivare.
En roll där du får se dina lösningar användas skarpt, varje dag, av kollegor runt om i världen.
Möjligheten att påverka din egen karriärutveckling och specialisera dig inom områden som intresserar dig.
Ett team av engagerade och erfarna kollegor som stöttar och utmanar dig.

Ansökan

Vi hanterar ansökningar löpande. Vänligen bifoga ditt CV och relevanta betyg från universitetsstudier till din ansökan.

För vissa roller genomför vi bakgrundskontroller som en del av rekryteringsprocessen. Kontakta ansvarig rekryterare om du har frågor om detta.

Gör skillnad tillsammans med oss på Sectra – vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

feel
your work.

As a Senior Agentic NetSuite Developer, you will play a crucial role in the Financial Systems team that owns the systems running Epidemic Sound's financial backbone. Your role will be to set the technical direction for our NetSuite platform, lead the architecture that connects it to the rest of our business, and shape how AI and agentic tooling change the way ERP work gets done here.

This focus on AI and agentic tools is central to our broader strategy of accelerating the company’s transformation toward smarter, more scalable ways-of-working by embedding agentic AI at the core of business operations and system development.

You'll Work At The Intersection Of Tech And Finance, Where The Systems You Build Directly Affect How Reliably We Close The Books, Run Controls, And Scale Operations As The Company Grows. Specifically

This role drives the modernisation of our ERP platform and integration landscape, ensuring Finance, Tech, and operational teams can move quickly on a foundation that's accurate, compliant, and built for scale.
Your work will reduce manual effort across financial processes, raise the bar on data integrity and audit-readiness, and define how we adopt AI capabilities inside NetSuite and beyond.
You'll join a small, senior team of ERP, CRM and Data engineers focused on internal business systems. It's a team that values craft, ownership, and clear technical judgement over process for its own sake, and which uses modern data tooling to optimise performance and scalability.
You'll collaborate closely with engineers across the Tech organisation, the Finance team (Accounting, FP&A, Controlling), Procurement, and external implementation partners — communicating directly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders without translation layers in between.
In collaboration with the team you will assess the technical problems, design best-practice solutions, and determine the appropriate implementation approach—whether through NetSuite development, configuration, or external systems (e.g., the pre-system data platform).

Your Key Responsibilities Include

Owning and evolving our NetSuite platform and AI strategy — directing AI-assisted development to accelerate delivery and reduce manual configuration, while maintaining a clear point of view on which of NetSuite's emerging AI capabilities and third-party agentic tools we should adopt and when.
Designing agentic workflows where AI handles repetitive financial processes — reconciliations, approvals, data routing — end-to-end, with appropriate human oversight built in.
Leading integration architecture across NetSuite and adjacent systems, acting as technical lead and quality reviewer for AI-generated scripts, integrations, and automations.
Driving compliance and continuous improvement, using AI-assisted analysis to proactively surface data integrity issues, audit risks, and optimisation opportunities.
Providing technical mentorship, supporting training materials to broaden ERP know-how across the organisation, and helping grow the Tech team through interviewing, onboarding, and contributing to best practices.

Requirements

At least 6 years of hands-on ERP experience with strong NetSuite expertise across configuration, SuiteScript, workflows, and integrations — ideally in a publicly listed or compliance-heavy environment.
A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Business Information Technology, or a related field.
An agentic development mindset. A genuine understanding of how AI coding assistants and agentic tools change the ERP specialist's role, with real experience reviewing and validating AI-generated outputs. You understand where agents add leverage and where human judgment is non-negotiable.
Deep knowledge of financial processes and ERP architecture, with the analytical ability to design solutions that hold up at scale and across complex, multi-variable scenarios.
Strong project leadership and stakeholder communication — a track record of driving initiatives from discovery to measurable business impact, and translating between business intent and technical execution without intermediaries.

It would also be music to our ears if you have

NetSuite/ERP systems and their integration with Salesforce
Invoice to pay software (e.g Medius), Spend management software (e.g Expensify), Consolidation software (e.g Aaro), Planning and Budgeting software (e.g NSPB)
Experience with SuiteCommerce Advanced or NetSuite’s Advanced Revenue Management (ARM) module.
NetSuite MCP Standard Tools SuiteApp
Familiarity with modern DevOps practices (CI/CD) for NetSuite development.
Agile methodology and how to work in agile teams.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
Own the backend services and APIs that turn a customer’s code into a threat model and carry it through to a fix.

Oplane is an always-on security expert for AI-first engineering teams. Our biggest focus today is PR Analysis: every pull request reviewed against the customer’s architectural threat model before it merges, with findings and code-level fixes attached rather than a report handed over. Scanners find patterns. Oplane understands the system. That is where we are now, not where we stop, and we ship new capabilities constantly.

You are a senior hire on that backend. There is a working system with paying enterprise customers on it, so you are not starting from a blank repo, but large parts of it are still the first version that got us here and need someone senior to make them hold at scale.

What you’ll own
The backend services and APIs that turn a customer’s code into a threat model and carry it through to a fix. Design, correctness, and the parts of reliability that live in the application layer.

What the job actually is
· Design and build the core backend. Python services, clean APIs, and the system design behind turning a customer’s code into a threat model and driving the fix. The analysis itself is AI-driven, so a lot of the interesting design is in orchestrating models reliably, not just moving data around. You own real system design here, not tickets handed to you fully specified.
· Build the APIs the product lives or dies by. Oplane only works when it is embedded in a customer’s repos, CI, pull request flow and coding agents. Part of that surface is how external coding agents talk to Oplane and run threat modeling directly. It has to be clean, stable, and hard to break, because other people’s pipelines and agents depend on it.
· Make it hold at enterprise scale. Companies with thousands of engineers, large codebases, concurrent analysis, and a lot of sensitive input passing through. You care about throughput, correct handling of customer code and secrets, and failure modes that do not silently drop a finding.
· Build the agentic way, because we mean it. This is the most agent-native codebase you are likely to have worked in. Our docs are written for coding agents to read, an agent reviews our pull requests, and we are building for a world where agents write most of the code. You will plan with an agent, build with one, and review with one, every day. We grow through agents rather than headcount, and if that reads as a threat to your craft rather than a multiplier of it, this is the wrong team.
· Work close to security. The whole product is about security architecture, and the team lives it, from prompt injection to secure-by-design, as a daily concern rather than an annual audit. You do not have to arrive as a security expert, but security experience is a real plus, and you should want to get good at it, because it is the domain the code is about.

Who this is for
· Around 10 years building backend systems in production. Depth in APIs, data, and system design matters more than any single language, and Python is a plus rather than a requirement.
· You think in architecture. You can hold a whole system in your head, see where it will break, own the design calls other people build on, and reason about a service end to end from data model to failure behavior.
· You can read what an AI agent produces and judge it. A lot of the code here is agent-written, and we need the architectural judgment to catch what it gets subtly wrong and steer it, rather than rubber-stamp it.
· You already use coding agents seriously in your own work and have opinions about where they help and where they do not. If you have not tried, this is the wrong team.
· Security experience is a strong plus. AppSec, secure design, working on a security product, or having been the person who reviewed everyone else’s threat model.
· Startup or scale-up background.
· Working language is English.

What you get
· A product with paying enterprise customers already running on the code you will own, so your work ships to real usage from week one. Teams like Miro, Tandem Health, Remotive Labs and Lightbringer already run Oplane, and we are SOC 2 certified.
· Real ownership of the backend, working directly with the founders.
· Backed by Seed Capital and Icebreaker.vc, with angel investors from Neo4j and Google, including Emil Eifrem. $5.2M seed.
· Based at our Malmö office, on-site five days a week. This is an in-person engineering team by design, not a distributed one.

How we work
Small team, ten of us today, real autonomy, and nothing between deciding something and doing it. We are honest about what is hard, including in this ad. We grow through agents rather than headcount, so the job is always to build the system that does the work rather than do the work by hand forever. Nobody here asks permission first. If you see it, do it, and tell us afterwards.

How to apply
Apply through the form on our site: https://www.oplane.com/careers/senior-backend-engineer
Use the Apply button on this post, which takes you there. We do not take applications through LinkedIn messages.

Tell us about a system you designed and one decision in it you would make differently now. Point us at code if you can.

jobs.description:
Vill du vara med och forma framtidens nätverksarkitektur i ett av Nordens mest välkända reseföretag? Trivs du i en roll där du får kombinera strategiskt inflytande med tekniskt hands-on arbete och samtidigt driva utvecklingen av moderna cloudlösningar? Då kan det här vara möjligheten du har väntat på.

OM ROLLEN

Som Cloud Network Architect hos Ving får du en central roll i företagets fortsatta transformation mot en molnbaserad och framtidssäkrad infrastruktur. Du ansvarar för att utveckla och forma nätverksarkitekturen med fokus på Azure, Cloud Networking och säker, skalbar kommunikation mellan verksamhetens plattformar och tjänster.

Rollen kombinerar arkitekturansvar med operativt arbete. Du driver tekniska initiativ, tar fram målarkitekturer och roadmaps samt omsätter idéer till lösningar i produktion. Samtidigt fungerar du som teknisk rådgivare och samarbetar nära utvecklingsteam, cloudspecialister, arkitekter och externa partners för att säkerställa att vår nätverksmiljö utvecklas i linje med bolagets cloudstrategi.

Här erbjuds du stort mandat, hög teknisk mognad och möjligheten att påverka framtida teknikval i en internationell verksamhet där innovation och utveckling står högt på agendan.

DIN PROFIL

Vi Tror Att Du Har

Djup kompetens inom Microsoft Azure och Azure Networking (VNET, Hub & Spoke-arkitektur, VWAN, NSG, Private Link & Private Endpoints, Azure Firewall)
Djup kompetens inom WAN och Hybrid Connectivity (WAN-design, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway, BGP, Private Link, Private Endpoint)
Erfarenhet av Cloud Architecture & Governance
Erfarenhet av Infrastructure as Code, exempelvis Bicep eller Terraform
Erfarenhet av Cloud Security och moderna säkerhetsprinciper (Zero Trust)
Vana av att samarbeta med utvecklingsteam och DevOps-miljöer
Har erfarenhet av att arbeta agilt
Relevant högskoleutbildning inom IT eller motsvarande kompetens

Meriterande Om Du Även Har

Erfarenhet av Datacenter & Enterprise Networking
Är certifierad inom IT arkitektur (ex. TOGAF, COBIT)
Azure-certifieringar (t.ex. AZ-305, AZ-400, AZ-700)

Som person är du engagerad, nyfiken och ansvarstagande. Du motiveras av att driva teknisk utveckling framåt och tycker om att omsätta strategier till konkreta resultat. Du är kommunikativ och har lätt för att skapa förtroende hos både tekniska och affärsnära intressenter. Dessutom är du prestigelös i ditt samarbete och trivs i en kultur där kunskapsdelning, initiativförmåga och laganda värdesätts högt.

OM ORGANISATIONEN

Ving är en del av Nordic Leisure Travel Group (NLTG) som säljer resor från Sverige, Danmark, Norge och Finland. I gruppen ingår researrangörerna Ving Sverige, Ving Norge, Globetrotter, Spies i Danmark, Tjäreborg i Finland, flygbolaget Sunclass Airlines samt våra egna hotellkoncept Sunwing Family Resorts, Ocean Beach Club och Sunprime Hotels. Gruppen säljer ett normalt år runt 1 250 000 resor i de nordiska länderna.

Vi erbjuder en spännande och utvecklande miljö där du får möjlighet till en intern karriär. Du får en omväxlande vardag tillsammans med härliga kollegor - vi arbetar i nära samarbete mellan de nordiska länderna för att ge våra gäster de bästa veckorna på året. Vi har dessutom ett högt medarbetarengagemang som år efter år visar sig i vår interna medarbetarundersökning. Vi älskar vårt jobb och välkomnar dig ombord på vår resa i Nordic Leisure Travel Group!

DIN ANSÖKAN

I denna rekrytering samarbetar NLTG
med Wise.

Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mail, utan du söker enkelt med ditt CV eller din LinkedIn-profil på wise.se
. Vi använder kompetensbaserad rekrytering som metod. Det gör vi i vår strävan efter en mer potentialbaserad matchning. Vi ser därför gärna sökanden med olika bakgrunder, åldrar och erfarenheter, eftersom vi vet att en bredare mångfald berikar var och en av oss och gör oss bättre och smartare som organisation.

anja.widell@wise.se
.

What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started.

Location:

Remote (Europe)

How You'll Make an Impact:

As a Staff Software Engineer
in Revenue Intelligence, you will shape the technical direction of systems that help hospitality businesses understand demand, identify revenue opportunities, and make better pricing and commercial decisions. You will work across customer-facing applications, backend services, data pipelines, analytical stores, recommendation workflows, and cloud infrastructure. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will solve complex engineering problems directly while establishing architecture, improving reliability and security, reducing systemic technical debt, and aligning multiple teams around durable technical decisions. Your impact will extend beyond individual features to the quality, scalability, operability, and long-term evolution of the Revenue Intelligence platform.

Our Revenue Intelligence Team:

The Revenue Intelligence team builds products and platforms that turn hospitality data into practical decisions for hoteliers, including pricing recommendations, demand insights, reporting, automation, and commercial opportunities. Our systems span frontend experiences, APIs, distributed services, data processing, machine-learning workflows, and production infrastructure. We value pragmatic engineering, strong ownership, evidence-based decisions, and technical leaders who raise the effectiveness of the people and systems around them.

What You Bring to the Team:

Set and evolve the technical strategy for Revenue Intelligence, translating product and business goals into coherent architecture and executable engineering plans
Lead the design and delivery of complex capabilities across customer-facing web applications, backend APIs, event-driven services, data pipelines, analytical storage, and recommendation workflows
Identify and resolve systemic risks in scalability, reliability, security, data quality, observability, and operability before they become recurring customer or engineering problems
Drive modernization of legacy systems and infrastructure through incremental, well-reasoned migrations that preserve delivery momentum and production stability
Partner with Product, Data Science, Infrastructure, Security, and engineering leaders to define boundaries, contracts, ownership, and long-term platform direction
Remain hands-on in the codebase through implementation, technical spikes, design reviews, debugging, incident response, and the most consequential or ambiguous engineering work
Raise the technical effectiveness of the wider organization through mentoring, architecture guidance, engineering standards, documentation, and constructive challenge

What Sets You Up for Success:

10+ years of software engineering experience, including significant technical leadership across complex production systems
Deep hands-on expertise in Python, with the ability to work effectively across both ecosystems and guide engineering decisions beyond a single language
Strong architecture and distributed-systems fundamentals, including API design, event-driven workflows, consistency, failure handling, scalability, and service boundaries
Experience with data-intensive systems such as PostgreSQL, Redshift, or similar analytical platforms, batch and streaming pipelines, and large-scale data processing
Experience designing or operating recommendation systems, machine-learning platforms, pricing systems, experimentation workflows, or other decision-support products
Strong cloud and platform engineering experience across AWS, containers, Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm, Argo CD, CI/CD, observability, and secure production operations
A demonstrated ability to lead through influence, create alignment across teams, communicate complex tradeoffs clearly, and drive decisions from ambiguity to execution
A strong record of improving engineering quality through testing strategy, operational readiness, incident learning, security, documentation, and sustainable technical standards
Product judgment and customer empathy, with the ability to connect technical investments to measurable outcomes for hoteliers and the business
Business-level English fluency and experience collaborating effectively in a remote, globally distributed organization

Bonus Skills to Stand Out:

Deep hands-on expertise in .NET/C#

Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team of redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ employees across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle.

Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary.
Learn more online at cloudbeds.com

Wallenius Wilhelmsen is a global leader in roll-on/roll-off (RoRo) shipping and vehicle logistics, operating 125 vessels and 66 processing centers across six continents. To achieve this, we are driving a large-scale digital transformation across all parts of our business. The Shipping D365 CE architect plays a key role in this journey, connecting our global operations through modern, integrated technology built on the Microsoft Dynamics 365 platform.

As Shipping D365 CE architect, you will take a leading role in shaping the technology architecture that supports Wallenius Wilhelmsen’s global shipping operations. You’ll translate business needs across areas such as capacity planning, booking management and vessel operations into scalable, secure and future-ready digital solutions.

You’ll collaborate closely with business stakeholders, digital leads, and engineering teams to ensure that technology decisions align with enterprise architecture, support operational excellence and enable sustainable growth.

Define and maintain the solution and domain architecture for the Shipping area within the Dynamics 365 and Power Platform ecosystem.

Translate functional and operational needs into practical technical designs and roadmaps.

At Wallenius Wilhelmsen, you'll join a global leader in shipping and logistics with more than 9,000 colleagues across 28 countries. jobs.description:
Would you like to use your skills to accelerate the global transition to a low-carbon circular economy?

About Cambi

Cambi is a world-leading provider of sustainable technology solutions that enable cities to turn wastewater sludge into valuable resources. We are a medium-size, Norway-based multinational company listed in Oslo on Euronext Growth, with offices in several countries. We have diligent employees from different backgrounds and more than 25 nationalities, and a growing sales network covering all continents.

Our core expertise lies in designing, testing, manufacturing, installing, and operating industrial process installations, used mainly for treating sewage sludge before or after anaerobic digestion in wastewater treatment plants. The technology, known as thermal hydrolysis, reduces greenhouse gas emissions and produces renewable energy, organic fertilizers, and various soil products while destroying pathogens and other harmful substances. Our systems have the capacity to cater to over 120 million individuals across more than 28 countries. We are proud of having cities like Oslo, London, Washington, Singapore, and Sydney among our clients.

About The Role

As a Business Applications Architect, you will be the technical owner of Cambi's Microsoft 365 landscape, ERP, CRM, and the integrations connecting them. You will translate business needs into platform functionality, aligned with the strategic direction for each system, and own the overall technical architecture across the full life-cycle of the platforms and their integrations – from design and implementation to ongoing evolution. This includes safeguarding the integrity, quality, and availability of the company's data as it flows across these platforms. The responsibility spans from high-level architectural direction to hands-on technical implementation, ensuring that strategic intent and operational detail remain consistently connected.

Key Responsibilities

Technically own the core business platforms and execute life-cycle enhancements to create business value.
Define and maintain architectural principles, standards, and documentation for Cambi’s core business applications and integrations.
Understand and translate business needs and foster cross-functional collaboration.

Embed data-driven thinking into architecture and technical decisions.
Operate within Cambi’s IT strategy, portfolio, priorities, and budget.

We are looking for

A data-first and data-driven mindset with a holistic way of thinking.
A consistent focus on ensuring that technology investments translate into tangible and measurable business value.
A genuine interest in platform solutions and the broader ecosystem they are part of.
A real appreciation for collaboration and cross-functional teams.
Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
A curious, technology-enthusiast approach to the work, with the drive and energy to help shape the role going forward.
Confident leading and participating in well-defined processes and appropriately scoped projects.
Willing to challenge the status quo, yet grounded and humble in how you do it.
Not afraid to get your hands dirty with day-to-day operational work, coding, and configuration.

Key qualifications and requirements

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline.
Relevant certifications and/or operational expertise within platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, ERP (platform-agnostic), CRM (Salesforce), integration development, and master data.
Significant, demonstrable experience in a comparable role is equally valid and will be given weight against formal education requirements.
Experience owning technical architecture and systems within a business context.

Hands-on skills in programming, scripting (PowerShell), and low-code (Power Automate, Power Apps) development within the ecosystem.

Methodical project management experience, ideally from platform implementations or major upgrades.

At Cambi, we value people who share our commitment to the environment and the positive impact of the circular economy. Your personality should align with Cambi’s core philosophy, which centers around strong customer focus, delivering a high standard of quality in our solutions, products, and services, and always acting with integrity.

Why Join Cambi

Work globally: Encounter different cultures and work practices when working with the global organization.

Immerse in diversity: Join a multicultural team with a mix of young and experienced colleagues from more than 25 countries and 18 different disciplinary backgrounds.
Grow personally: Embrace our values: quality, curious, reliable and teamwork, in a dynamic work environment grounded in a modern Code of Conduct applying to all employees and business partners.

How to Apply

If you’re ready to take the next step in your career with us, we’d love to hear from you. We kindly ask you to upload your CV and answer three questions regarding your motivation for the role.

Delivering on our mission to enable a swift global transition to sustainable communities is contingent on attracting and retaining talented employees from diverse backgrounds.

jobs.title: PhD Candidate in Empirical Software Engineering
jobs.description:
About The Position

As agile development scales to larger, more complex organizations, software engineering is being transformed by a set of intertwined changes. Continuous software engineering is converging development and operations to enable frequent releases, while AI is touching every stage of the software lifecycle, bringing agents that work alongside developers. Together, these changes are reshaping team composition and dynamics, as well as enabling shorter feedback loops, while introducing new roles and requiring new skillsets.

The purpose of empirical software engineering research is to study these shifts as they unfold, examining real-world practice to generate knowledge that can guide how teams and organisations build quality software. As a PhD Candidate, you will carry out this work within the Software Engineering group at the Department of Computer Science, one of Norway's leading software engineering environments. The group works closely with industry and publishes at leading international venues.

Your immediate leader will be the head of unit.

Duties of the position

Develop research-based knowledge on continuous software development, grounded in empirical studies.
Carry out empirical studies in Norwegian software companies, with the aim of publishing in recognised journals and conferences.
Responsible for conducting your own studies and for taking part in project teams together with master's students.
Contribute to teaching activities, including lab sessions and supervision
Other career-promoting work agreed with the department, such as work on smaller related research projects or collaboration with organisations in the public and private sectors. Applicants who hold a position outside the university may, by agreement, retain part of that position as career-promoting work.

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.

Required Selection Criteria

You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
You must have a relevant Master’s degree in computer science or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis.
You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
You must master English as a professional language, both written and orally.
You must attach a project outline (1500 words) to your application. It should set out your theoretical and methodological approach to the research topic, together with proposed research questions.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.

Preferred Selection Criteria

Academically relevant background within software engineering or information systems

Experience from the software industry
Experience with empirical studies and scientific publishing
Good oral and written presentation skills in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to:

A good team player
A good communicator
Eager to learn
Results-oriented
Work independently

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.

We offer

An exciting job with an important mission in society
Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
Working capital that can be used to implement the project
Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals.

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education.

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.

Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary.

The employment period is 4 years for the doctoral work in addition to 1 year of career promotion work. (A minimum of three work years of the total term period must be dedicated to doctoral work.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Computer Science within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme throughout the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

About The Application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in Norwegian/a Scandinavian language or English.

Please note:
the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The Application Must Include

Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
CV
Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages)
Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page)
Possibly publications etc. other relevant research work
Possibly certificates
Names and contact information of three relevant referees

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).

General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Joakim Klemets (Associate Professor), phone +47 413 51 921, email: joakim.klemets@ntnu.no.

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR at hr@idi.ntnu.no.

Application deadline: 08.10..2026

About Us

We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.

As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.

About Maritime

We help enhance the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of our customers in the global shipping industry, covering all vessel types and mobile offshore units. As a partner to industry, we offer services in testing, certification, training, and technical advisory through the energy value chain. That means we’re continually investing heavily into R&D for new services and solutions while proactively assessing what the industry needs today and tomorrow.

About The Role

Are you ready to kick-start your career as a Summer Student in Maritime Technical Support next summer?

With 15,000 employees operating in over 100 countries, DNV is a leading expert in risk management and assurance. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.

DNV Maritime’s AI Centre of Excellence - Smart Use of Data
enable AI in DNV Maritime’s tools and global work processes, strengthening DNV’s leading position in digital innovation.

We are 40+ developers and data scientists developing AI solutions in a professional setup. We are delivering innovation with AI to DNV’s business processes in close collaboration with domain experts and project teams.

You will be part of the AI Platform Engineering team, consisting of 10-15 professional programmers delivering scalable cloud hosting services and data platform to our AI solutions.

Typical tasks as a summer student in DNV Maritime would be:

You will be part of a professional cloud platform team providing AI hosting and data platform for smart use of data
You will be working on real development project(s) where your contribution is aimed deployed to production by the end of the summer
You will be part of projects improving or expanding our AI hosting platform and/or data platform

You will experience highly motivated colleagues and a strong company culture and many social activities

About Us

We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.

As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.

About Group Functions

Group functions in DNV are experts on finance and accounting, human resources, communication and sustainability, legal, tax and compliance – providing company-wide support, governance and strategic projects. Group also includes our strategic Research and Development unit, which provides science-based insights and foresight to tackle transformations and challenges across the industries we serve.

About The Role

We are looking for students in their 3rd or 4th year
of studies who are interested in the future of safety-critical and software-intensive systems.

Modern ships, energy systems and industrial assets are becoming increasingly autonomous, connected and data-driven. As these systems grow in complexity, society needs new ways of understanding whether they remain safe, reliable and compliant throughout their lifecycle.

In this project, you will explore how engineering knowledge, requirements, safety objectives, operational data and simulation results can be combined to support informed and trustworthy decisions.

Working together with students focusing on simulation and risk analysis, you will investigate questions such as:

How can we understand the impact of design changes, software updates or maintenance actions?
How can requirements be traced throughout the lifecycle of a system?
What information is needed to justify confidence in a safety-critical system?
How can engineering evidence be structured and updated as systems evolve?
How can future classification and certification processes become more digital, dynamic and data-driven?

The work combines elements of systems thinking, software engineering, safety, AI-enabled engineering and decision support for complex technical systems.
