jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking an elite, highly independent Principal Software Engineer & Architect who views advanced AI coding harnesses and multi-agent frameworks not as a crutch, but as a force multiplier for rapid, high-quality execution.

In this role, you will not be a cog in a massive machine, nor will you be stuck managing a single legacy codebase. Instead, you will act as a solo "special forces" engineer, moving dynamically from project to project. You will take loose, highly ambiguous business requirements and autonomously transform them into production-ready, enterprise-grade software. Your projects will span the entire functional spectrum—from building complex client portals to engineering mission-critical dispatch systems.

Because our applications deploy across a mix of Azure cloud and secure, on-premises environments, you must possess an uncompromising mindset regarding data sovereignty, rigid deployment constraints, and architectural security.

What You Will Do

Architect & Execute: Autonomously design, code, and deploy secure, scalable applications from scratch using C#/.NET and JavaScript/Node.js. You own the entire pipeline from blueprint to production.

Navigate Ambiguity: Translate vague, high-level business concepts into robust system architectures without requiring granular specifications or hand-holding.

Adapt and Pivot: Shift gears fluidly between rapid-prototyping greenfield sprints (2–4 weeks) and deep-dive enterprise deployments (3–6 months).

Own the Security Lifecycle: Ensure all codebases are rigorously hardened against the OWASP Top 10 and strictly adhere to secure, on-premises infrastructure requirements.

Orchestrate AI Workflows: Integrate your own preferred multi-agent frameworks and AI toolchains to accelerate development velocity, while maintaining absolute human oversight of logic, edge cases, and architectural integrity.

Who You Are

An Independent Thinker: You don't wait for a ticket to be fully groomed. You figure out what needs to be built, challenge assumptions when necessary, and deliver the right solution.

An AI Realist: You understand that AI is prone to hallucinations and lazy logic. You know how to orchestrate multi-agent workflows to handle the heavy lifting, but your own architectural expertise is what ensures the system is stable, secure, and performant.

A Full-Stack Enterprise Builder: You have deep, production-tested experience within both the Microsoft ecosystem (C#, .NET) and modern JavaScript/Node.js environments.

A Security-First Engineer: You have a proven track record of architecting for strictly controlled, hybrid, or on-prem environments where security cannot be an afterthought.

Requirements

7+ years of experience in enterprise-level software engineering and hands-on system architecture.

Mastery of C# / .NET and JavaScript / Node.js.

Strong experience designing hybrid architectures spanning Azure cloud and on-premises infrastructure.

Deep, practical understanding of OWASP Top 10 principles and secure coding practices.

Proven experience leveraging advanced AI coding assistants, custom multi-agent frameworks, or LLM-orchestrated workflows to significantly compress delivery timelines.

Exceptional ability to work entirely solo, owning projects from concept to deployment.

Why Join Us?

If you are tired of endless committee meetings, rigid corporate bureaucracy, and being locked into one mundane codebase for years, this is your playground. You will have the autonomy to choose your own AI workflow toolchain, the freedom of a fully remote position, and the challenge of building entirely different enterprise systems from scratch back-to-back.

new_jobs.title: Senior .NET Developer
new_jobs.description:
Creëer je eigen toekomst

Als Senior .NET Developer in het Nexus-team help je de basis bouwen voor toekomstige digitale oplossingen binnen onze Private Clients-activiteiten.

Het Nexus-team is verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen van een Operational Data Store (ODS): een centraal dataplatfom dat informatie uit meerdere bronsystemen samenbrengt, standaardiseert en beschikbaar maakt voor applicaties binnen de hele organisatie. Door een consistente en betrouwbare datalaag te creëren, stellen we ontwikkelteams in staat om beter gebruik te maken van data. Hoewel dit een Senior .NET Developer rol is, ligt de focus vooral op backend-ontwikkeling.

Dit is een zeer autonome rol in een lean team. Je bouwt niet alleen oplossingen, maar helpt ook mee aan het vormgeven van de toekomst van het platform. Je werkt in een complexe omgeving waar bedrijfsprocessen, applicaties en datamodellen samenkomen.

Wij geloven dat de beste oplossingen ontstaan door eerst het probleem écht te begrijpen. Daarom zoeken we iemand die nieuwsgierig is, graag onderzoekt hoe dingen werken, actief het gesprek aangaat met stakeholders, aannames uitdaagt en complexe vraagstukken vertaalt naar schaalbare technische oplossingen.

Je verantwoordelijkheden:

Ontwerpen, bouwen en onderhouden van services en applicaties bovenop de Operational Data Store
Ontwikkelen van backendfunctionaliteit en integraties met C# .NET en Azure SQL
Meewerken aan het migreren van functionaliteit van bestaande API’s naar de nieuwe datalaag waar dat passend is
Integreren en standaardiseren van data uit meerdere bronsystemen
Bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van het datamodel en de platformarchitectuur
Intensief samenwerken met business stakeholders, architecten en developmentteams om requirements te begrijpen en verbeterkansen te identificeren
Onderzoeken van complexe data- en applicatielandschappen en oplossingen voorstellen die zowel business- als technische behoeften in balans brengen
Eigenaarschap nemen van analyse tot en met implementatie

Jouw talenten

Als Senior .NET Developer ben je zelfstandig, analytisch en proactief. Je vindt het prettig om te werken in een omgeving waar niet alles vooraf is vastgelegd en waar het ontdekken van de juiste oplossing onderdeel is van je werk. Je bent iemand die echt wil begrijpen hoe dingen werken. Je stelt vragen, daagt aannames uit en voelt je comfortabel bij het vormen én onderbouwen van je eigen visie op technische en functionele besluiten.

Daarnaast heb je:

Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met C# .NET-ontwikkeling
Sterke kennis van SQL en relationele databases
Ervaring met het bouwen van integraties tussen systemen en applicaties
Ervaring met Azure-gebaseerde oplossingen
Affiniteit met datamodellering en complexe datastructuren
Sterke analytische vaardigheden en probleemoplossend vermogen
Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen samen te werken met zowel technische als niet-technische stakeholders
Ervaring met werken in Agile-teams

Zet je volgende stap bij Van Lanschot Kempen

Samen met uiteenlopende klanten toekomstgerichter, duurzamer en datagedreven beleggen. Zowel nationaal als internationaal. Met ruim 300 jaar ervaring maken we van die ambitie realiteit bij Van Lanschot Kempen. Dat doen we met zo’n 2.100 collega’s verdeeld over verschillende expertises.

Binnen het Nexus-team sluit je aan bij een groep senior professionals in een Scrumteam met een duidelijke missie: het creëren van een betrouwbare en toekomstbestendige datafundament voor applicaties binnen het Private Clients-domein. Omdat het team lean is, heeft jouw bijdrage directe impact op de richting van het platform. Je krijgt de kans om invloed uit te oefenen op technische beslissingen, oplossingen vorm te geven en te werken aan vraagstukken waarin software engineering, architectuur en data samenkomen. We bieden een omgeving waarin eigenaarschap, nieuwsgierigheid en initiatief worden gewaardeerd. Technische expertise is belangrijk, maar jouw vermogen om complexiteit te doorgronden maakt uiteindelijk het verschil.

De mate van innovatie en wendbaarheid van een organisatie is mede afhankelijk van de diversiteit van het personeelsbestand. Dankzij onze verschillen, versterken we elkaar. Wij stimuleren een inclusieve werkomgeving waarin alle collega's zich thuis voelen. Bij ons mag jij gewoon zijn wie je bent. En daar zijn we trots op.

Benieuwd naar verhalen van collega’s en hoe zij het werken bij Van Lanschot Kempen ervaren? Ga naar Podcasts en kom meer te weten!

Dat is wat we doen. Als jij waarde toevoegt, mag je hetzelfde van ons verwachten. Een goede werk-privébalans via onze ‘hybride manier van werken’ is daar een goed voorbeeld van. Als Senior .NET Developer krijg je daarnaast:

a gross monthly salary between €5.500 and 7.000 commensurate with your knowledge and experience.
additional flexible budget of 19.47% of your gross salary (containing a 13th month, 8% holiday allowance & 7 extra legal leave days) You can utilize this by buying a bike, monthly gym membership, but also to save up for a sabbatical! It’s also possible to get the full budget paid out at any moment in the year.
an employee share plan, where Van Lanschot Kempen doubles your investment (of max. €3.500 a year) in Van Lanschot Kempen shares.
27 leave days of which 7 are part of the flexible budget.
working from home equipment such as electric standing desk, chair, a number of screens of your choice can be ordered and sent to your home.
your commute to work is compensated, including green options of walking and biking to work!
working from home allowance.
the option of exchanging national public holidays for religious holidays.
a free Van Lanschot Kempen bank account and other employee conditions, such as a discount on an Evi (investment) account.
a market competitive pension scheme. The exact contribution is based on your salary and age, generally, most people can expect around 20% contribution, which 4% is employee contribution.
a number of communities and events throughout the year, communities such as Young Professionals, Women, International, Pride, Sustainability, Sports clubs etc.
weekly drinks at our bar in the office.
Dutch and English language courses.
Hybrid working with flexibility, with the team typically in the Amsterdam office two days a week, Monday and Friday

And we have many other employment benefits ready for you. Discover all the benefits of working at Van Lanschot Kempen.

Wil jij meebouwen aan een toekomstbestendig platform voor miljoenen klanten van a.s.r.? En hierbij een voortrekkersrol vervullen binnen de organisatie? Word Senior Back-end Developer bij a.s.r. in Utrecht.

Als Senior Back-end Developer werk je aan de centrale Customer Identity & Access Management-dienstverlening (CIAM) van a.s.r., een van de grootste verzekeraars van Nederland. Je bouwt mee aan een toekomstbestendig platform voor inloggen en registreren, speelt een belangrijke rol in de cloudtransitie en krijgt veel ruimte om nieuwe technologieën te verkennen, waaronder AI. Daarnaast help je collega’s zich te ontwikkelen en heb je directe invloed op de architectuur en technische richting van een bedrijfskritisch platform. Ben jij klaar om jouw expertise in te zetten én verder uit te bouwen? Solliciteer op deze vacature van Senior Back-end Developer.

Dit ga je doen als Senior Back-end Developer bij a.s.r.
Je ontwikkelt, beheert en verbetert bedrijfskritische CIAM-services die een belangrijke rol spelen in de digitale klantreis van a.s.r
Je neemt technisch eigenaarschap over onderdelen van het platform, bewaakt kwaliteit en onderhoudbaarheid en draagt actief bij aan de verdere cloudtransitie.
Je hebt een voortrekkersrol in het team, stimuleert samenwerking over disciplines heen en zorgt voor heldere communicatie tussen techniek en Security en Architectuur.
Je helpt het team nieuwe technologieën te onderzoeken en implementeren hoe AI-oplossingen verantwoord kunnen bijdragen aan betere softwarekwaliteit, efficiëntere processen en een hogere ontwikkelsnelheid.
Je begeleidt junior en medior developers in hun vakinhoudelijke en professionele ontwikkeling en helpt het team groeien in kwaliteit, eigenaarschap en vakmanschap.

Dit bieden we je
een bruto salaris van € 4.600 - € 6.800 op basis van 38 uur per week, een 13e maand en 8% vakantievergoeding. Een thuiswerkvergoeding en korting op verzekeringen
een goede pensioenregeling met veel flexibiliteit en een hoge bijdrage van de werkgever
een NS-Business Card met vrij reizen (ook privé) of een kilometervergoeding
veel aandacht voor je ontwikkeling, je inzetbaarheid en je gezondheid
hybride werken: gemiddeld 60% vanuit huis en 40% op kantoor en veel ruimte om je eigen werktijden te bepalen
werk waarmee je een positieve invloed hebt op de samenleving van morgen; samen stropen we onze mouwen op voor een eerlijkere en duurzamere toekomst

Deze vacature is echt iets voor jou, want jij
hebt ruime senior ervaring met Microsoft .NET/.NET Core, bij voorkeur 7 jaar of meer
hebt aantoonbare ervaring met Microsoft Azure in productieomgevingen, bij voorkeur 5 jaar of meer
hebt ervaring met CI/CD, testautomatisering en codekwaliteit
hebt kennis van security-by-design en ervaring in enterprise-omgevingen
hebt ervaring met monitoring, logging en troubleshooting

Hier ga je werken als Senior Back-end Developer in Utrecht
Je komt terecht in het scrumteam Accounts & Inlog, onderdeel van de IT-afdeling van a.s.r. Het team is verantwoordelijk voor Customer Identity & Access Management (CIAM) en ontwikkelt bedrijfskritische diensten voor het inloggen en registreren van klanten. Het multidisciplinaire team bestaat uit 11 collega’s die nauw samenwerken aan veilige, betrouwbare en schaalbare oplossingen. De sfeer is informeel: er wordt hard gewerkt, maar ook veel gelachen. Je werkt intensief samen met developers, Security en Architectuur. We werken hybride, waarbij we twee dagen per week op kantoor zijn. Daarnaast organiseren we regelmatig teamdagen die we afsluiten met een gezamenlijke borrel en/of etentje.

Sollicitatieprocedure
Neem bij inhoudelijke vragen contact op met Maikel Vaesen (Product Owner): maikel.vaes@asr.nl. Vragen over het proces kun je stellen aan Kamal Omarouali (Recruiter) via WhatsApp (06-48739789) of e-mail (kamal.omarouali@asr.nl)

Wij werken op een prettige manier samen met een aantal preferred suppliers. Acquisitie door werving- en selectie-, detachering- of uitzendbureaus wordt daarom niet op prijs gesteld

new_jobs.title: Web developer
new_jobs.description:
Web Developer

Join us at Hillebrand Gori a company of DHL Global Forwarding

Introduction

Being specialized in alcoholic beverages, we offer a full range of transportation services and options, from full container loads to groupage shipments, from large volumes of bulk wine to small consignments via airfreight. Our logistics services allow our customers to transport exactly what they want, when they want, in a cost effective way.

To support our continued growth and digital transformation, we are expanding our software development team with a Web Developer. In this role, you will join our software development department of 35 professionals covering analysis, development, and testing. The team is highly autonomous and works closely with Product Owners to build in house, business driven applications.

Our architecture is Angular, API first, cloud native, and centered around Microsoft Azure, with Apigee for API management and Okta for identity and access management. Knowledge of WEB design is highly valued.

To be successful as a WEB developer, you are analytical, technically strong, and comfortable translating business requirements into robust, secure, and scalable software solutions.

What will you do?

As a WEB Developer, you will:

Develop and maintain scalable web applications using modern front end (Angular) and back end (Dotnet) technologies within Azure
Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code following best practices and coding standards
Collaborate with UI/UX designers to implement responsive and intuitive user interfaces
Optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability
Implement security and data protection measures
Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members
Write and maintain technical documentation

What do we expect from you?

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in an Informatics or IT related field
Proven experience as a WEB developer
Strong proficiency in front end technologies: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), and modern frameworks (Angular preferred, React or Vue.js)
Experience with Agile development methodologies
Experience with version control systems (Git)
Knowledge of web security best practices and OWASP guidelines
Good command of the English language (spoken and written)
Currently living in The Netherlands within commuting distance of Haarlem

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with cloud platforms (Azure)
Experience with CI/CD pipelines
Experience with testing frameworks and TDD
Knowledge of TypeScript

How does the process work?

Throughout September and October, we will review and shortlist potential candidates. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for onsite interviews in October.

  Why work at Hillebrand Gori?

With great pride, we can say that Hillebrand Gori is the largest beverages logistics company in the world. Founded in 1844, we are active in over 90 countries. Our success is built on the dedication of our people. While we operate globally with more than 2,200 employees, our IT department is largely located in The Netherlands but also has a presence in Italy, France and India. Within our department around 15 different nationalities work together.

We believe that “Our people and our reputation are our greatest assets.” You will work in an environment where you can make impact, influence strategic technology decisions, and grow both personally and professionally.

Are you looking for a role where you can apply deep WEB development expertise, shape technical architecture, and deliver direct business value? Then we’d like to meet you.

What can you expect from us?

A salary tailored to your qualities and experience
A contract for 40 hours
Reimbursement for travel expenses, work from home allowance and internet allowance
Pension scheme with BeFrank
Flexible working hours and possibility to work from home
Personal growth and challenging work with endless possibilities to realize your ambitions in an international environment
An informal working environment with innovative colleagues who strive for the very best
You can work independently and make us better with your own input
Professional training
a fun place to work, with room for recreation; weekly and monthly drinks, quarterly company meet ups, regular company festivities
Work for an organization certified as Great Place to Work 2026

new_jobs.description:
De rol in het kort

Start in ons team en ontwikkel jezelf tot world-class Developer, Release Engineer, System Integrator of Architect. Bij Deloitte.

Benefits

Je deelt bij ons mee in de winst, boven op een vast salaris.
Altijd blijven groeien met ons development program.
Flexibele werktijden en hybride werken, afgestemd op je team en je klantverplichtingen.
26 vakantiedagen per jaar bij een fulltime dienstverband en de mogelijkheid om extra dagen in te kopen.

Ruil 3 nationale feestdagen voor 3 niet-nationale feestdagen, als je wilt.
Een tijd-voor-tijdregeling. Gebruik de tijd die je op het ene moment meer maakt op momenten die er voor jou toe doen.

Een goede mobiliteitsregeling: de keuze uit verschillende opties zoals een leaseauto, reizen met het OV, een cash budget of een combinatie daarvan.
Vergoeding om je thuiswerkplek op een ergonomisch verantwoorde manier in te richten én een internetvergoeding.
De mogelijkheid om gebruik te maken van 55 uur oppasdienst per kalenderjaar, als jouw kind 12 jaar of jonger is.

Een pensioenregeling waarbij je eigen bijdrage slechts 2% is.

Fiscaal voordelige regelingen, zoals bedrijfsfitness, het aanschaffen van een fiets tegen bruto salaris of de mogelijkheid om een fiets te leasen.

Zes weken volledig betaald geboorteverlof voor traditionele huishoudens en regenbooggezinnen.

Meer over benefits

What's in it for you?

Je deelt bij ons mee in de winst, boven op een vast salaris.
Altijd blijven groeien met ons development program.
Flexibele werktijden en hybride werken, afgestemd op je team en je klantverplichtingen.
26 vakantiedagen per jaar bij een fulltime dienstverband en de mogelijkheid om extra dagen in te kopen.
Parttime (32 uur) of fulltime (40 uur) werken.
Ruil 3 nationale feestdagen voor 3 niet-nationale feestdagen, als je wilt.
Een tijd-voor-tijdregeling. Gebruik de tijd die je op het ene moment meer maakt op momenten die er voor jou toe doen.

Een goede mobiliteitsregeling: de keuze uit verschillende opties zoals een leaseauto, reizen met het OV, een cash budget of een combinatie daarvan.
Vergoeding om je thuiswerkplek op een ergonomisch verantwoorde manier in te richten én een internetvergoeding.
De mogelijkheid om gebruik te maken van 55 uur oppasdienst per kalenderjaar, als jouw kind 12 jaar of jonger is.
Een laptop en iPhone. De iPhone mag je ook privé gebruiken.
Een pensioenregeling waarbij je eigen bijdrage slechts 2% is.
Mogelijkheid om deel te nemen aan de collectieve zorgkostenregeling.
Fiscaal voordelige regelingen, zoals bedrijfsfitness, het aanschaffen van een fiets tegen bruto salaris of de mogelijkheid om een fiets te leasen.
Een maandelijks budget waarmee je keuzes kunt maken in flexibele arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals extra vakantiedagen of het financieren van een fietsplan.
Zes weken volledig betaald geboorteverlof voor traditionele huishoudens en regenbooggezinnen.

Be the true you

Natuurlijk ontdek je voortdurend nieuwe manieren om moeilijke problemen op te lossen en wil je tot de kern van het echte probleem van de klant komen. Maar het allerbelangrijkste is dat je de ware jij bent. De enige echte jij. Met jouw persoonlijke sterktes, kijk op de wereld en unieke persoonlijkheid. Voor de functie van Junior Engineer binnen ons Customer team heb je de volgende kwalificaties nodig:

Een diploma in het hoger/universitair onderwijs op het gebied van Computer Science, Software Engineering/Development, Artificial Intelligence, of andere relevante formele onderwijservaring.
Ervaring met programmeertalen zoals Python, Apex (zeer vergelijkbaar met Java), JavaScript, SQL, HTML en CSS.
Vaardigheid in Git-versiebeheer, inclusief branching-strategieën (feature branches, main/develop), commit-hygiene, en merge-management, aangevuld met basiskennis van CI/CD-pipelines voor productie-deployments.
Kennis van en ervaring met methoden en technieken zoals Salesforce, Mendix, en Agile/SCRUM zijn een pluspunt. Alle kandidaten krijgen support en trainingen in Salesforce en Agile/SCRUM methoden, afgestemd op de kennis en ervaring die je al hebt.
Je wordt enthousiast van het oplossen van complexe puzzels en je hebt gedemonstreerde interesse in IT/Technologie en procesoptimalisatie, met bijzondere focus op het implementeren van geavanceerde AI-technologieën (GenAI, Conversational AI, Voice Assistants) voor klantgerichte oplossingen.
Wij werken met klanten en teams over de hele wereld. Een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en geschrift is een vereiste.

What impact will you make?

Bij ons Customer team bouwen we de toekomst van sales en service. We ontwerpen en implementeren next-generation, digitally enabled capabilities die welbekende bedrijven transformeren. Met cutting-edge technologieën zoals Salesforce en MuleSoft als ons arsenaal, vertalen we complexe bedrijfsuitdagingen in elegante technische oplossingen.

Jij bent de katalysator van deze transformatie: je schrijft code, configureert systemen en fungeert als technisch sparringpartner voor onze klanten. Tegelijk groei je voortdurend via ons Delivery Excellence Program—een intensief ecosysteem van trainingen, kennisdelingssessies en certificeringen die je naar het volgende level tillen.

Wil je graag meer weten over Deloitte Digital? Bezoek onze pagina of neem een kijkje op onze LinkedIn .

How do you do this?

We zijn op zoek naar een nieuwe Junior Engineer om ons bestaande en gevestigde Engineering team te versterken om klantgerichte digitale oplossingen te ontwikkelen om de volgende generatie Sales en Service-mogelijkheden van onze klanten te leveren. De rol zal in eerste instantie developer-gericht zijn en biedt je een geweldige kans om je carrièrepad vorm te geven om uit te groeien tot een Senior Developer, System Integrator, of een Architect. Jouw rol binnen ons Customer team is het vervullen van de volgende vereisten:

Het verkennen en toepassen van innovatieve technologieën zoals Agentic AI, Conversational AI, Voice Assistants en andere geavanceerde oplossingen, met de focus op het stimuleren van creatief denken en het aanjagen van impactvolle bedrijfsinnovatie.
Het leveren van applicaties (bv. gebruikersinterfaces, Sales- en Serviceprocessen , Contact Centers, B2C- en B2B-community's, API's, mobiele apps, Agentforce) die voldoen aan de best practices en zo haalbaar mogelijk zijn.
We stellen kwaliteit en veiligheid voorop en streven naar schaalbare excellentie—standaarden die groeien zonder te buigen.
Je gaat samenwerken in vaak multidisciplinaire- en culture teams bij klanten die Agile werken om nieuwe functionaliteit te ontwikkelen en implementeren in het toonaangevende SaaS-platform Salesforce.
Je werkt in nauw verband met de klant en draagt actief bij aan zowel functionele als technische workshops. Samen verzamelen en documenteren jullie de eisen, waarna jij innovatieve technische oplossingen ontwerpt en realiseert. Je geniet van de flexibiliteit om dit zowel on-site als remote in te vullen, afhankelijk van de behoeften van het project.
Je bent gedreven om jezelf voortdurend te ontwikkelen, zowel professioneel als persoonlijk. Bij DF&O creëren we daar actief ruimte voor: je werkt samen met een coach die je helpt je uitdagingen aan te pakken, je deelt kennis in regelmatige sessies met collega's, en je hebt volledige vrijheid om trainingen te volgen en relevante certificaten te behalen die jou naar het volgende niveau brengen.

We zouden je graag willen leren kennen!

We zijn benieuwd naar wie jij bent. Waarin jij verschilt van anderen. Bij Deloitte geloven we dat onze onderlinge verschillen bijdragen aan het beste resultaat voor onze klanten. Stel je aan ons voor en solliciteer op deze vacature.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer (Java, C++) - Remote
new_jobs.description:
About Oneleet

Oneleet is a rapidly growing security and compliance platform focused on making cybersecurity and compliance more effective, accessible, and straightforward for businesses.

The platform helps companies build, manage, and monitor cybersecurity programs while working toward compliance standards such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001. Oneleet monitors cloud environments across AWS, GCP, and Azure, helping identify security risks such as exposed storage, inadequate encryption, overly permissive IAM policies, and compliance gaps.

Following a $33 million Series A, Oneleet is expanding its customer base and engineering organization as it works to reshape the cybersecurity and compliance industry.

About the Role

Oneleet is seeking a Software Engineer, Integrations to build and maintain the integrations that connect its security platform with cloud providers, security tools, and third-party services.

This is a backend-heavy engineering role focused on reliability, data quality, and integration coverage. You will ensure that Oneleet can consistently collect the right security signals from external systems and make that information available to downstream security and compliance features.

As part of the engineering team, you will collaborate closely with the founding team and other engineers to understand business and customer needs and help build the core technology powering the Oneleet platform.

Key Responsibilities

Build and maintain integrations with AWS, GCP, and Azure cloud environments.

Develop integrations with third-party security tools and external services.

Discover cloud resources, synchronize configurations, and surface relevant security data.

Design data pipelines that normalize and validate inputs from diverse APIs.

Handle real-world API challenges including inconsistent responses, pagination, rate limits, and evolving schemas.

Implement authentication flows using OAuth 2.0, OIDC, API keys, and service accounts.

Build reliable and recoverable integrations with strong error handling and retry mechanisms.

Implement monitoring, observability, and alerting for integration failures and operational issues.

Create clear documentation covering integration behavior, data mappings, and troubleshooting procedures.

Improve engineering standards, tooling, and reusable patterns that make future integrations faster to develop.

Collaborate with engineering teams to understand downstream data requirements.

Ensure integrations consistently deliver the data required by Oneleet's security platform.

Required Qualifications

3+ years of professional software development experience, particularly in backend APIs, integrations, or data pipelines.

Experience with strongly typed compiled programming languages such as:

Go

Java

C#

C++

Rust

Strong preference for Go experience.

Experience integrating with REST APIs and working from API documentation.

Ability to handle real-world API behavior and integration challenges.

Experience working with SQL.

Experience building or maintaining SaaS platform backends.

Strong problem-solving abilities and a willingness to take ownership of technical challenges.

Comfortable working independently in an environment that values initiative and accountability.

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of authentication standards including OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and SAML.

Professional experience in information security.

Familiarity with cloud provider APIs and SDKs, including:

AWS SDK

GCP client libraries

Azure SDK

Experience with integration testing and debugging tools.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field.

Cloud & Integration Technology

The role focuses heavily on building reliable integrations across modern cloud and SaaS environments.

Cloud Platforms

Amazon Web Services (AWS)

Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

Microsoft Azure

Integration Technologies

REST APIs

API Documentation

Data Pipelines

API Authentication

OAuth 2.0

OIDC

API Keys

Service Accounts

Programming

Go

Java

C#

C++

Rust

Data

SQL

Data Normalization

Data Validation

API Data Synchronization

Engineering Focus

You will help build the foundational integration layer that powers Oneleet's security capabilities.

Key engineering challenges include:

Reliable API integrations

Cloud resource discovery

Configuration synchronization

Security data collection

Data normalization and validation

API rate-limit handling

Pagination and schema changes

Error handling and retry logic

Observability and alerting

Integration testing

Backend SaaS development

Who We're Looking For

Oneleet values passionate self-starters with a growth mindset, a bias toward action, and strong personal accountability.

The company is particularly interested in engineers who:

Enjoy solving difficult technical problems.

Are comfortable working in ambiguous environments.

Challenge outdated approaches and look for better solutions.

Are decisive while remaining collaborative.

Communicate clearly and take ownership of their ideas.

Want to make a meaningful impact on the product and company.

Remote-First Work Environment

Oneleet operates as a remote-first company and hires globally in regions where it can legally engage employees directly or through an employer-of-record partner.

The role is listed in Amsterdam, Netherlands, while the company supports global hiring based on applicable employment arrangements.

Perks & Benefits

Comprehensive health and wellness benefits.

20 days PTO per year, plus 8 floating holidays.

Remote-first work culture.

Team off-sites in locations such as Amsterdam and Italy.

Competitive compensation and equity.

Geographic pay bands based on work location and local market conditions.

Compensation is determined based on work location, skills, experience, and relevant education or training. The company notes that posted compensation ranges reflect a U.S. national baseline and may be adjusted for different geographic markets.

Why Join Oneleet?

This is an opportunity to work on the foundational technology behind a modern cybersecurity and compliance platform.

As a Software Engineer, Integrations, you will directly influence how Oneleet connects with cloud platforms, security tools, and third-party services. Your work will help organizations automate security processes, improve compliance, and maintain more secure cloud environments.

You will also have the autonomy to make meaningful technical contributions while working alongside a passionate engineering team in a rapidly growing Series A startup.

Equal Opportunity

Oneleet is an equal opportunity employer committed to making hiring decisions based on merit, skills, and potential, regardless of location or other characteristics protected by applicable law.

new_jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
new_jobs.description:
Creëer je eigen toekomst

Als Senior Full Stack Developer bouw je digitale oplossingen die vermogensplanners ondersteunen bij het begeleiden van cliënten bij een van de belangrijkste beslissingen in het leven: het plannen van de overdracht van vermogen over generaties heen.

ClientCenter is het centrale platform dat door onze commerciële collega’s wordt gebruikt en wordt uitgebreid met nieuwe functionaliteiten die vermogensplanners helpen om klantsituaties beter te begrijpen, opvolgingsprocessen te stroomlijnen en meer persoonlijke adviezen te geven. Jouw werk draagt direct bij aan het verbeteren van de manier waarop onze collega’s cliënten ondersteunen bij het realiseren van hun langetermijndoelen op het gebied van vermogen.

Dit is een sterk samenwerkende rol waarin technologie, inhoudelijke expertise en gebruikersbehoeften samenkomen. Wij geloven dat de beste producten worden gebouwd door teams die dicht bij hun gebruikers staan. Daarom zoeken we iemand die nieuwsgierig is, sterk op de gebruiker gericht, en graag zowel het zakelijke domein als de mensen die dagelijks met de software werken wil begrijpen.

Je verantwoordelijkheden:

Ontwerpen, bouwen en onderhouden van schaalbare applicaties en services
Ontwikkelen van end-to-end oplossingen met moderne full-stack technologieën
Intensief samenwerken met vermogensplanners om gebruikersprocessen te begrijpen, aannames te toetsen en oplossingen te leveren die aantoonbare waarde creëren
Vertalen van complexe vermogens- en opvolgingsvraagstukken naar robuuste, veilige en goed onderhoudbare software
Een diepgaand begrip ontwikkelen van het Belgische vermogens- en opvolgingsdomein en actief bijdragen aan het vormgeven van digitale oplossingen in dit gebied
Samenwerken met andere ontwikkelteams binnen de cluster om naadloze, geïntegreerde klantreizen te realiseren
Bijdragen aan architectuurbeslissingen, technisch ontwerp en de verdere ontwikkeling van het platform
AI inzetten gedurende de volledige software development lifecycle, met behoud van hoge standaarden voor kwaliteit, security en onderhoudbaarheid
Eigenaarschap nemen van analyse tot implementatie en release
Continu verbeteren van ontwikkelpraktijken, testaanpakken en systeembetrouwbaarheid
Junior teamleden coachen en ondersteunen via kennisdeling, feedback en technische begeleiding

Jouw talenten

Als Senior Full Stack Developer combineer je sterke technische expertise met nieuwsgierigheid naar het zakelijke domein en de mensen die de producten gebruiken die jij bouwt. Je neemt eigenaarschap, communiceert effectief met zowel technische als niet-technische stakeholders, en voelt je comfortabel in complexe omgevingen waar business en technologie samenkomen.

Daarnaast heb je:

Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Full Stack Developer
Gedegen ervaring met C# .NET, Angular en moderne webdevelopment-technologieën
Ervaring met Azure-gebaseerde oplossingen
Een pragmatische aanpak van AI-ondersteunde softwareontwikkeling, waarbij je productiviteitswinst afweegt tegen degelijk engineeringoordeel
Sterke samenwerkingsvaardigheden en ervaring in het werken met meerdere teams en stakeholders
Een sterke interesse in het begrijpen van eindgebruikersprocessen en het verbeteren van de gebruikerservaring
Het vermogen om snel complexe functionele domeinen te doorgronden en te vertalen naar technische oplossingen
Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en ervaring in Agile teams

Zet je volgende stap bij Van Lanschot Kempen

Samen met uiteenlopende klanten toekomstgerichter, duurzamer en datagedreven beleggen. Zowel nationaal als internationaal. Met ruim 300 jaar ervaring maken we van die ambitie realiteit bij Van Lanschot Kempen. Dat doen we met zo’n 2.100 collega’s verdeeld over verschillende expertises.

Je komt in een Scrumteam dat digitale oplossingen ontwikkelt en doorontwikkelt ter ondersteuning van vermogens- en opvolgingsplanning binnen het Private Clients-domein. Werkend over de volledige stack help je oplossingen creëren die complexe processen vereenvoudigen en collega’s ondersteunen bij het geven van hoogwaardig advies aan cliënten. Je krijgt de kans om invloed uit te oefenen op technische beslissingen, bij te dragen aan de productontwikkeling en mee te bouwen aan best practices binnen het team.

De mate van innovatie en wendbaarheid van een organisatie is mede afhankelijk van de diversiteit van het personeelsbestand. Dankzij onze verschillen, versterken we elkaar. new_jobs.description:
Create your own future

Are you a great engineer ready to take on a new challenge, bridging native mobile development and backend API development? We are looking to extend our team with a passionate fullstack engineer who is strong in either native iOS development or backend REST API development in C#/.NET — and has working knowledge of the other side. You understand the full landscape needed to run enterprise apps reliably, including APIs, authentication, and CI/CD.

The Client AI & Analytics team is building AI-powered tools inside ClientCenter, our custom platform used by private bankers, relationship managers, and other commercial staff to manage client relationships and deliver highly personalized client service at scale. We build practical, impactful AI tools that fit naturally into how bankers and advisors actually work, always with humans firmly in the loop.

Over the past period, the team has added a growing set of AI-powered capabilities to the platform, including meeting preparation, live transcription, automated documentation, data quality improvements, and compliance support. We are now taking the next step: developing a native iOS app, backed by our C#/.NET API layer, that makes these intelligent capabilities available anytime, anywhere, on secure managed devices within our corporate environment.

As a fullstack engineer, you will help build the corporate mobile app and the backend that powers it, enabling our commercial colleagues to work faster, smarter, and more effectively, with AI-assisted ClientCenter functionality right at their fingertips.

Your talents

"Passionate about mobile and backend technology, AI, growth mindset, collaborative and hands-on" — this is how we can best describe you in this role. You use these talents to continuously improve the digital experience of our commercial colleagues.

You have strong experience in at least one
of the following, and working
knowledge of the other:

iOS development

3+ years of experience developing native iOS apps, preferably with Swift and SwiftUI
Strong understanding of REST architectural principles (resources, statelessness, idempotency, proper use of HTTP methods/status codes) and experience applying this when consuming APIs in a mobile context
NET API development
3+ years of experience developing REST APIs in C# / .NET
Track record of designing robust, maintainable, and scalable APIs — sound architectural choices that hold up as the platform and usage grow

Across both profiles, you also have:

Familiarity with design patterns, testing (unit/integration tests), continuous integration and deployment
Solid understanding of Clean Architecture and MVVM principles, and experience with dependency injection
Knowledge of and hands-on experience with Azure is a strong plus

What makes you stand out:

Experience with setting up and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in Azure (for example Azure DevOps, Azure Pipelines) for mobile apps.
Experience developing and deploying corporate mobile apps in managed environments, such as Mobile Device Management (MDM) solutions like Microsoft Intune (e.g. app protection policies, app configuration, distribution to managed devices).
Affinity with broader software engineering topics (logging, monitoring, observability, security-by-design) and collaborating with backend / platform engineers.

Move ahead at Van Lanschot Kempen

Investing in a more future-oriented, sustainable, and data-driven way with various clients. Both nationally and internationally. With nearly 300 years of experience, we make this ambition a reality at Van Lanschot Kempen. We do this with more than 1,800 colleagues in various fields of expertise.

The Digital Innovation & Analytics department is a start-up like environment within Van Lanschot Kempen; a union of two specialised financial boutiques and the oldest independent financial institution in the Netherlands. This means a work environment which offers both; the cool and ambitious character of a start-up combined with the solid benefits of a large company.

An organisation's degree of innovation and agility also depends on the diversity of its workforce. Our differences make us stronger together. We promote an inclusive work environment where all colleagues feel at home. With us, you can be yourself. And we are proud of that.

Curious about the stories of colleagues and how they experience working at Van Lanschot Kempen? Go to Podcasts and find out more

That's what we do! The fact is, if you add value, you can expect the same from us in return. A good work-life balance with our 'hybrid way of working' is a good example of this. As a Fullstack Engineer - iOS & .NET API, you will also be given:

a gross monthly salary between €5.000 and 6.200 commensurate with your knowledge and experience.
additional flexible budget of 19.47% of your gross salary (containing a 13th month, 8% holiday allowance & 7 extra legal leave days) You can utilize this by buying a bike, monthly gym membership, but also to save up for a sabbatical! an employee share plan, where Van Lanschot Kempen doubles your investment (of max. €3.500 a year) in Van Lanschot Kempen shares.

working from home equipment such as electric standing desk, chair, a number of screens of your choice can be ordered and sent to your home.
your commute to work is compensated, including green options of walking and biking to work!
working from home allowance.
the option of exchanging national public holidays for religious holidays.
a free Van Lanschot Kempen bank account and other employee conditions, such as a discount on an Evi (investment) account.

a number of communities and events throughout the year, communities such as Young Professionals, Women, International, Pride, Sustainability, Sports clubs etc.
weekly drinks at our bar in the office.
Dutch and English language courses.

Als Fullstack Developer bij Loyalis, een belangrijke inkomensverzekeraar in het zuiden van Nederland, werk je aan de vernieuwing van een belangrijk digitaal platform voor klanten en collega's. Je speelt een centrale rol in de migratie van de bestaande Sitecore-omgeving naar een moderne headless ContentStack-omgeving en helpt mee om het platform klaar te maken voor de toekomst. Daarbij ligt de nadruk op front-endontwikkeling met Vue.js, Nuxt en TypeScript, terwijl je ook betrokken bent bij API's en de verdere modernisering van de back-end. Je werkt samen met ontwikkelaars, testers, een businessanalist en de product owner aan oplossingen die dagelijks worden gebruikt. Bovendien krijg je ruimte om je verder te ontwikkelen richting back-enddevelopment en mee te denken over de technische koers van het platform. Wil jij bouwen aan een nieuw digitaal platform binnen een betrokken team dat volop in ontwikkeling is? Solliciteer dan nu als Fullstack Developer bij Loyalis, onderdeel van a.s.r.!

Dit ga je doen als Fullstack Developer bij a.s.r.
je ontwikkelt en verbetert de front-end van het nieuwe digitale platform met Vue.js, Nuxt en TypeScript

je vertaalt ontwerpen naar toegankelijke, schaalbare en onderhoudsvriendelijke front-endoplossingen
je koppelt front-endcomponenten aan API's en ContentStack

je werkt mee aan de migratie van technisch complexe functionaliteit naar nieuwe API's en services

je draagt bij aan het ontwikkelen en onderhouden van API's in .NET, inclusief documentatie via Swagger

een bruto salaris van € 4.100 - € 5.800 op basis van 38 uur per week, een 13e maand en 8% vakantievergoeding. Een thuiswerkvergoeding en korting op verzekeringen
een goede pensioenregeling met veel flexibiliteit en een hoge bijdrage van de werkgever
een NS-Business Card met vrij reizen (ook privé) of een kilometervergoeding
veel aandacht voor je ontwikkeling, je inzetbaarheid en je gezondheid
hybride werken: gemiddeld 60% vanuit huis en 40% op kantoor en veel ruimte om je eigen werktijden te bepalen
werk waarmee je een positieve invloed hebt op de samenleving van morgen; samen stropen we onze mouwen op voor een eerlijkere en duurzamere toekomst

Deze vacature is echt iets voor jou, want jij
hebt ervaring met Vue.js, Nuxt en TypeScript of vergelijkbare moderne front-end frameworks
hebt ervaring met contentmanagementsystemen; ervaring met een migratietraject is een pré (bijvoorbeeld Sitecore of een headless CMS zoals ContentStack)

hebt affiniteit met back-endontwikkeling en API-integraties

hebt bij voorkeur ervaring met businessanalyse, requirementsanalyse en technische analyse
communiceert gemakkelijk met collega’s en werkt graag samen binnen een scrumteam

Hier ga je werken als Fullstack Developer in Heerlen
Je gaat aan de slag in Team Apollo binnen Loyalis. Samen met ongeveer 7 DevOps-engineers, een product owner en een scrum master werk je aan de Loyalis-website en de verwerking van nieuwe polisaanvragen. Daarbij krijg je te maken met verschillende technologieën, zoals Sitecore en ContentStack, Vue en Nuxt, .NET-services en OutSystems. Het team werkt in sprints van 3 weken en komt 2 keer per week samen op kantoor voor overleg, samenwerking en kennisdeling. De overige dagen kun je vanuit huis werken. Loyalis, een merk van a.s.r., is dé verzekeraar voor inkomen en zekerheid binnen de sectoren overheid, onderwijs, zorg, vervoer, bouw en nutsbedrijven. We bieden producten en diensten op het gebied van arbeidsongeschiktheid en helpen onze klanten om uitval te voorkomen. Werken bij Loyalis heeft nog méér voordelen: een fijne werksfeer, een uitstekende werk-privébalans, alle ruimte om je verder te ontwikkelen én de mogelijkheid om thuis te werken! new_jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer - Moonpay Enterprise
new_jobs.description:
MoonPay Enterprise is for builders with something to prove.

This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend.

MoonPay Enterprise is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes.

AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.

You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.

The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building the rails that businesses run real money on, for humans and agents. MoonPay ranked #2 in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100, made Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 (Top 25 in Finance), and landed on The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running.

The role

We’re hiring backend engineers across several openings within MoonPay Enterprise. All roles share the same foundation of designing and operating reliable, secure, high-throughput backend services, but each opening has a distinct focus. When you apply, tell us which track (or tracks) excites you most.

Track 1: KYB / KYC & Compliance Platform

Build the systems that let enterprises onboard safely and stay compliant across dozens of jurisdictions. You’ll own services powering business (KYB) and individual (KYC) verification flows, risk scoring, sanctions and AML screening, case management, and integrations with identity and compliance vendors. The challenge is making rigorous compliance feel invisible: fast, automated, and globally scalable, without ever compromising on regulatory obligations.

Track 2: New Product Lines, starting with Custody

Join us at the ground floor of new enterprise products, beginning with Custody. You’ll design the backend for secure digital asset storage and management for institutional clients: key management workflows, policy engines, transaction authorization, ledger integrity, and audit trails. This track suits engineers who love ambiguity, greenfield architecture, and building products from zero to one with enterprise-grade security requirements.

Track 3: Blockchain, Stablecoin Issuance & On-Chain Infrastructure

Work directly with blockchain protocols to power our stablecoin issuance business and on-chain products. You’ll build and operate services for minting, burning, and managing fully reserved stablecoins across chains, develop smart contract integrations on EVM chains and Solana, and design the indexing, monitoring, and reconciliation systems that keep on-chain and off-chain state in sync. Prior Solana (Rust) or Solidity development experience is a strong plus here.

Across all tracks, experience with fiat rails, banking integrations, or payments systems is very welcome. Much of our hardest work happens where traditional finance and crypto overlap.

What you’ll do

Design, build, and operate backend services written in Rust that process high volumes of financial transactions with strong guarantees around correctness, idempotency, and auditability
Own features end to end, from shaping the product spec through technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production monitoring. You won’t just receive work from product: as a domain expert, you’ll help define what we build and propose the work you consider most useful
Integrate with external partners such as banks, payment processors, blockchains, and identity and compliance vendors, and build the abstractions that make those integrations reliable
Improve engineering quality across observability, incident response, security practices, and API design
Collaborate closely with product, compliance, and other engineering teams across MoonPay’s global network
(Staff level) Set technical direction for your area, mentor other engineers, and drive architectural decisions that span multiple teams

About You

5+ years of backend engineering experience (8+ for Staff), with a track record of shipping and operating production systems at scale
Strong backend experience with a statically compiled language (e.g. Rust, Go, C#, C++) is a must. Deep fundamentals matter more to us than your specific language history
Prior professional Rust experience is not required, but interest in Rust and motivation to become an expert in it are very welcome, since our services are written in Rust
Solid fundamentals in distributed systems, API design, data modeling, and asynchronous processing
Comfort working in domains where precision matters, such as financial systems, double-entry ledgers, reconciliation, or similarly correctness-critical software
A pragmatic, autonomous, ownership-driven mindset. You care about outcomes, communicate clearly, and thrive on high throughput: on this team, features ship in hours to days and products in days to weeks
Strong critical thinking, including in how you use AI tools. You know how to drive AI-assisted development productively while staying firmly in control of correctness, security, and design quality
Interest in crypto, stablecoins, and the future of payments. Prior crypto experience is a plus rather than a requirement, except for Track 3, where hands-on blockchain development experience is expected

Bonus points

Professional or hobby experience writing Rust (open-source contributions count!)
Experience in fiat payments, banking integrations, card networks, or PSPs
Familiarity with KYC/KYB, AML, sanctions screening, or regulated financial products (Track 1)
Background in custody, key management (MPC/HSM), or institutional-grade security (Track 2)
Smart contract development in Solidity (EVM) or Rust (Solana), and experience with on-chain indexing or node infrastructure (Track 3)
Experience working in regulated, multi-jurisdiction environments

How we work

MoonPay Enterprise operates like a startup inside a scale-up: small, senior, high-throughput teams with real ownership, direct access to customers and decision-makers, and the backing of MoonPay’s global licenses, banking relationships, and distribution network. We move fast and expect engineers to act as product owners for their domain, not just implementers. This role is open fully remote, or hybrid from our Berlin, Germany hub if you prefer time with the team in person.

The Agreements team within AWS Billing is looking for a Software Development Engineer to join our team in Berlin.

Are you interested in building the next generation, cloud-based commerce system for AWS that’s used by millions of customers worldwide? Are you excited by the idea of building real-time stream processing systems that operate at millions of records scale? Do you want to make an impact at a several-billion-a-year business? Computing AWS bills, at its core, is a challenging, distributed systems problem that requires calculations performed over trillions of usage records, millions of accounts, and hundreds of thousands of different rates. What Sets Us Apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

You will join the Identity and Access Management team
. Owning DeepL's full identity stack: organisation, account and session management, SSO federation, SCIM provisioning, and the OIDC provider, for both internal and external users. When identity is unavailable, no one can log in, so reliability and performance sit at the heart of everything the team does.

We are shifting gears from "Software-First" to "Product-First." We don't hire engineers to simply maintain legacy endpoints or close Jira tickets. We hire Missionaries
— builders who obsess over the Why before the How. You will contribute across the stack, shipping features that create delightful, frictionless experiences for both external developers and internal engineering teams.

Your Responsibilities

Own the Identity Experience End-to-End: You will architect and build complex, user-facing features across our identity stack. You will own business-critical systems from the initial problem definition through to architectural design, deployment, and production reliability. You measure success by user impact, not just pull requests merged
Build for "Consumer-Grade" Enterprise: You understand that authentication and authorization systems cannot fail. You build for reliability and maintainability, while delivering a user-friendly experience. You will lead incident response, and continuously raise the bar on code quality and operational health
Collaborate to Raise the Bar: You will work closely with teammates across Identity and adjacent teams - other product teams, Product Management and Support. You will lead designs, scoping, shaping, and solving hard product and technical challenges in collaboration with your team and other engineers
Drive Technical Pragmatism: Whether using our core stack (C#/.NET Core, Kubernetes, Postgres) or exploring new tools, you choose the technology that solves the customer problem most effectively, ensuring long-term maintainability over short-term trends. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving

Extreme Ownership & Operational Excellence: You own your services end-to-end (production operations, incident response, and on-call) and you're motivated by pushing reliability toward four nines. A "System Thinker" Mindset: You don't just know syntax; you understand failure modes, system boundaries, and how your code impacts the broader architecture at scale. You can design systems that deliver high availability for our millions of users.
Backend Mastery at Scale (C# / .NET): You have deep expertise designing scalable backend systems and distributed architectures, and you've worked with high-scale distributed systems in production. Strong system design is core to how you work. Roughly 80-90% of the work is backend; working on the frontend (React/Javascript) is a welcome plus, not a requirement

Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

Not just another building society. Not just another job.

We're the fourth biggest building society in the UK and what makes us a bit different is that we're a mutual organisation. We don't have shareholders; we're owned by our members.

Whatever your background, and whatever your goals, we'll help you take the next step towards a better future.

Skipton values work/life balance and we are proud to support hybrid and flexible working, where possible. We have a newly refurbished head office which offers a vibrant and collaborative working space.

We have a range of other benefits available to you including

Annual discretionary bonus scheme

25 days standard annual leave + bank holidays + rising 1 day per year of service to a maximum of 30 days

Holiday trading scheme allowing the ability to buy and sell additional annual leave days

Matching employer pension contribution (up to 10% per annum)

A commitment to training and development

3 paid volunteering days per annum

Diverse and inclusive colleague networks available for you to join including our Carers and Pride Alliance groups

We care about your health and wellbeing – we provide a range of benefits that support this including cycle to work initiative and discounted gym membership

What Will You Be Doing?

You will lead end-to-end technical delivery of solutions for our Customer Engagement Platform built on Microsoft Dynamics 365. Ensure solutions are designed and engineered using appropriate methods and tools, aligned to organisational strategy, security, and standards. Drive adoption of best practices in solution architecture and ALM to meet business goals, deliver value to stakeholders, and manage technical risk. Provide technical leadership and mentoring to engineers, fostering a collaborative, high-performance culture.

What Do We Need From You?

Lead and take ownership across all stages and iterations of Dynamics delivery.
Plan, drive, and evaluate Dataverse solution construction (tables, relationships, forms, views, model-driven apps) aligning with engineering and security standards
Design and implement server-side extensions (C# plug-ins, custom workflow activities) and client-side behaviours (TypeScript/JavaScript, form/context APIs)
Define and execute robust integration patterns using Azure Functions, Service Bus, Webhooks, virtual tables and API Management; ensure observability with Application Insights
Automate business processes with Power Automate (cloud flows) with error handling
Establish ALM practices: solution layering, environment strategies, CI/CD using Power Platform Build Tools and Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions.
Assure security-by-design (environment roles, security roles, field security, DLP policies) and compliance (auditing, GDPR)
Set quality standards via reviews, Solution Checker, static analysis and test automation
Optimise performance and scalability (plugin pipeline optimisation, batching, concurrency controls, index strategy)
Provide production support leadership, troubleshooting complex incidents and driving root-cause remediation via controlled releases.
Evaluate emerging platform capabilities and their organisational impact. Champion continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.

We’re looking for someone who blends technical expertise with curiosity, creativity, and a passion for improvement.

Ideally, You’ll Have

Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Functional Consultant Associate (PL-200)
Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Customer Service Functional Consultant Associate (MB-230)
Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate (PL-400)

If you’re excited by the potential of automation and want to help shape the future of how we work, we’d love to hear from you.

You will hit the ground running: building AI-enabled products with large language models and modern agent frameworks and directing AI coding assistants to deliver at pace. You will turn concepts from our architects and product managers into working software quickly, challenge technical design and delivery choices, and bring the analytical rigour needed to take AI solutions safely into production.

Practical experience building with AI and agentic technologies: large language models, RAG, prompt engineering, and agent frameworks / orchestration (such as LangChain, LangGraph or Semantic Kernel).

Our group is highly distributed and the right candidate will thrive in an environment of asynchronous communication. We expect you to have excellent written communication skills and be able to create working relationships with coworkers in locations around the globe.

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, United Kingdom

Overview

GitHub is seeking a Staff Software Engineer
to join the Git Systems Engineering team, which runs the largest code-hosting platform in the world, part of our Platform and Infrastructure organization. Our group is responsible for the services that store and serve Git repositories, both directly to users and to other layers in the GitHub software stack. We build the various microservices, protocols, proxies, and control systems that power Git operations at GitHub and operate them at scale.

You will work on real-world, large-scale distributed systems and help design, build, and support highly available, performant, and scalable services that enable the next generation of AI-driven software development by improving Git code-hosting platform through wide-reaching, cross-team work.

Our group is highly distributed and the right candidate will thrive in an environment of asynchronous communication. We expect you to have excellent written communication skills and be able to create working relationships with coworkers in locations around the globe.

Prior experience solving problems with large-scale, distributed systems is preferred.

(i.e. Petabytes of storage, millions of objects, low latency, high throughput with millions of QPS)

Design, develop, test, and ship high-quality technical solutions that scale across multiple GitHub services; build deep familiarity with the systems you own; and write maintainable code.

Maintain operations of live services as issues arise on a rotational, on-call basis. Implement and support others to build solutions and mitigations to complex issues impacting the performance or functionality of Live Site services.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
At Longshot Systems we build advanced platforms for sports betting analytics and trading.

We're looking for a Software Engineer to join the team that owns and develops our trading platform. Longshot is a small, focused company and so the role suits someone who can architect and implement whatever is needed to meet our next product, performance or stability goal. The team owns the technical standards and coding guidelines, CI/CD, observability and security. This role suits someone who wants to ship features and contribute to the wider technical excellence in the team and platform.

The trading platform at Longshot handles integrations with many bookmakers and exchanges worldwide. It normalises and combines the global odds data for many sports and makes it available internally for strategies to trade on. We handle thousands of odds updates and trades per second and have very strict bounds on latency, correctness and overall quality of the feed and trading. You would be at the heart of this team: integrating more trading venues, optimising key parts of the platform, making trading safer and faster, etc. We also maintain a significant historical data repository and support wider trading and research efforts around the company.

Our key platform systems are all in Golang, with message buses and databases at the core of the architecture. You don't need to be fluent in Golang, but it would help. It's easy to learn and we have a team full of experts able to teach you.

We are a hybrid working company, working Thursdays in our London (Farringdon) office and flexible the rest of the week. Our typical working hours are 10 am to 6 pm UK time, Monday to Friday, but we support flexible working and trust our team to manage their own schedules to meet their goals.

Interview Process

Intro call (30 mins) - your background + interests
1st Technical interview (30 mins) - live code review & pair programming
2nd Technical interview (60 mins) - deep dive technical questions
Full assessment day (10:30-5pm) - a one day systems programming exercise designed to be similar to the real work we do in the team. Meet some of the team, see the office, have a nice lunch (on us)

Requirements

Bachelors or Masters in a quantitative or technical subject (e.g. Maths, EE, Physics, Comp Sci) from a top university
2+ years experience building mission critical distributed systems (finance, gaming, telco, ad-tech, etc.) where throughput, correctness and availability are a hard requirement
Proven track record delivering and maintaining production systems in at least one systems language (Go, C++, Rust, Java, C#, etc.), with clear, idiomatic designs
Startup experience: shipping products in small, fast moving teams
Architecture & design: Able to reason about trade offs and produce clean, evolvable service boundaries
Cloud & DevOps: comfortable working in AWS, linux and wrangling build pipelines. We have dedicated DevOps people, but you do need to be competent in the core skills here
Fluent written and spoken English. Communicating with the team is as important as the technical work. You need to be able to effectively collaborate on everything from low level details to long term strategic planning

Nice to have

Trading, market making or exchange experience

Benefits

Participation in the uncapped company bonus scheme
10% matched pension contributions
Private healthcare insurance
Long term illness insurance
Gym membership

new_jobs.title: AI-Enabled Product Engineer – Aladdin, Investments & Trading Engineering, Vice President
new_jobs.description:
About This Role

Vice President, AI-Enabled Product Engineer – Aladdin, Investments & Trading Engineering

Location:
Edinburgh

About The Role

BlackRock is seeking a Vice President, AI-Enabled Product Engineer to join Aladdin, Investments & Trading Engineering within Analytics & Compliance Engineering. This role is for a hands-on engineering leader who can build scalable agentic solutions while helping accelerate the adoption of AI-enabled engineering practices across the product development lifecycle.

The successful candidate will work at the intersection of investment technology, investment compliance workflows, full-stack engineering, and applied AI. They will help design and deliver capabilities across the Aladdin platform that support investment professionals, compliance teams, and business stakeholders operating in complex global markets.

About Aladdin, Investments & Trading Engineering

Aladdin is BlackRock’s technology platform used by investment professionals to manage portfolios, analyse risk, execute workflows, and make decisions at scale. Within Investments & Trading Engineering, Analytics & Compliance Engineering develops technology that helps teams manage investment guidelines, regulatory obligations, analytics-driven workflows, and operational controls across global markets.

The Investment and Trading Compliance Engineering team is responsible for developing and maintaining tools to ensure that organizations using Aladdin® comply at different stages of the asset management process. This includes ensuring that clients follow guidelines established internally, by themselves, and by the market regulators. The system accomplishes this through high-throughput rule-based compliance engines, which sit at the heart of the investment system and process millions of calculations per day.

Our engineering teams build products with real reach, real complexity, and real impact. We are evolving our platform with persona-based, workflow-driven experiences, modular architecture, resilient services, and responsible AI capabilities that improve productivity, decision-making, knowledge discovery, and operational efficiency.

What You’ll Do

Design, build, and deliver high-quality full-stack Agnetic product capabilities across the Aladdin platform, with a focus on Analytics & Compliance Engineering workflows.
Act as a hands-on technical leader across the product development lifecycle, contributing to technical design, implementation, testing, deployment readiness, production support, and continuous improvement.
Partner with product managers, engineers, compliance specialists, and business stakeholders to translate complex business problems into clear specifications, technical designs, delivery plans, and actionable Agile backlogs.
Apply AI-enabled engineering practices to accelerate design exploration, prototyping, software development, testing, code review, documentation, and operational support.
Help embed responsible AI capabilities into product workflows and platform services, including intelligent assistants, workflow automation, semantic search, knowledge retrieval, and reasoning over compliance and investment information.
Build scalable, resilient, and operable systems that balance functional requirements with non-functional concerns such as performance, latency, reliability, security, observability, and maintainability.
Influence architecture and technical direction across initiatives, articulating design trade-offs and aligning stakeholders around pragmatic engineering choices.
Champion engineering excellence through test-driven development, behaviour-driven development, DevOps practices, production readiness, and an SRE mindset.
Mentor engineers, raise the bar for technical quality, and contribute to a culture of continuous learning, innovation, accountability, and collaboration across a global engineering organisation.

Qualifications

Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related STEM discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including experience delivering enterprise-scale systems in production.
Strong full-stack engineering background, with hands-on experience in modern backend and frontend technologies.
Proven ability to lead technical initiatives, shape ambiguous problem spaces, define execution plans, and deliver outcomes through collaboration with cross-functional partners.
Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, distributed systems, APIs, data flows, event-driven architecture, and resilient platform design.
Experience applying modern Agile, DevOps, and engineering excellence practices to improve delivery quality, team productivity, and operational outcomes.
Excellent communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Skills And Experience

Hands on experience with AI enabled SDLC / PDLC practices, including:
Using AI to accelerate design exploration, prototyping, and architectural decision making
Applying AI assisted development, testing, code review, and documentation practices
Embedding AI capabilities into product workflows and platform services responsibly and securely
Frameworks such as Devin / Windsurf, Cursor or GitHub Copilot
Hands-on full stack experience with Java or other modern backend languages, and frontend frameworks such as React or Angular.
Experience designing and operating APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and event-driven architectures at enterprise scale.
Exposure to Generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, semantic search, embeddings, knowledge retrieval, or agentic workflow patterns.
Strong focus on software quality, including automated testing, TDD, BDD, code review discipline, observability, resiliency, and production support.
Ability to reason about scalability, reliability, security, cost, maintainability, and delivery velocity when making technical decisions.
Experience working in large, global engineering organisations and collaborating across locations, time zones, product areas, and stakeholder groups.
Ability to build domain context quickly and translate investment, analytics, or compliance workflows into robust product and platform capabilities.

Preferred Experience

Experience in financial services, investment technology, compliance technology, regulatory technology, portfolio management, trading, or enterprise SaaS platforms.
Familiarity with compliance workflows, investment guidelines, rule intelligence, regulatory obligations, or controls-oriented technology.
Experience with cloud-native or hybrid architectures, containerisation, Kubernetes, observability platforms, CI/CD, and modern platform engineering practices.
Experience with AI governance, responsible AI principles, evaluation frameworks, model quality metrics, or monitoring of AI-enabled systems.
Exposure to domain-driven design, micro frontend architectures, platform strategies, or modular product architectures that enable multiple teams to deliver independently and consistently.

Our Benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of employee benefits including: retirement investment and tools designed to help you in building a sound financial future; access to education reimbursement; comprehensive resources to support your physical health and emotional well-being; family support programs; and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. A demonstrated ability to lead through influence, create alignment across teams, communicate complex tradeoffs clearly, and drive decisions from ambiguity to execution

Deep hands-on expertise in .NET/C#
